competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-2
competitions.summary: 从示例网格推断变换规则，再解出新的网格。
competitions.summaryEN: Infer a transformation from example grids and apply it to a new grid.

guide.zh: 先把一题中的输入与输出并排看，分清哪些颜色、物体和空间关系保持不变。给候选规则换一个训练示例，检查它能否解释全部变化。记录整道题是否完全解对，逐像素平均容易掩盖规则错误。
guide.en: Place the input and output grids side by side and mark which objects, colors and spatial relations survive the transformation. Test a candidate rule against every demonstration before applying it to the unseen grid. Track whole puzzles solved as well as pixel errors.

competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3
competitions.summary: 通过交互探索陌生环境，推断动作与目标之间的关系。
competitions.summaryEN: Explore unfamiliar interactive environments and infer how actions advance the goal.

guide.zh: 与静态网格推理相比，这里还要决定下一步观察什么。挑一个环境，逐步记下动作、画面变化以及当前假设，区分偶然变化和可重复的规律，再用另一条路径验证假设。
guide.en: Here the solver also chooses what to observe. For one environment, record each action, the screen change and your current hypothesis. Replay a different sequence to separate a repeatable interaction from a coincidence.

competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - Paper Track
competitions.summary: 用研究论文解释 ARC 推理方法及其证据。
competitions.summaryEN: Document and evaluate a reasoning approach for the ARC Prize research track.

guide.zh: 读论文时先写下作者想解释的推理能力，再检查实验能否把它与记忆样例区分开来。把方法、对照、失败题型分开记录，最后查看官方征稿说明中的评审标准。
guide.en: Start with the reasoning capability the paper claims to measure. Read the controls and failure cases to see whether the experiment separates generalization from memorizing examples. Use the official paper-track criteria to interpret the evidence.

competitions.title: Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development
competitions.summary: 在随时间采集的三维图像中定位并跟踪细胞。
competitions.summaryEN: Locate and track cells across a sequence of three-dimensional images.

guide.zh: 这里既要在单帧找到目标，也要把相邻时刻的检测连成轨迹。挑一段短序列，分别标记漏检、重复检测和轨迹身份交换。这样可以判断改进应集中在定位还是跨帧关联。
guide.en: Separate two tasks while reading a solution: locating each object in one volume and linking detections over time. Inspect a short sequence and label missed detections, duplicates and identity switches to find which stage accounts for an error.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2022
competitions.summary: 识别夏威夷声景录音中的鸟鸣。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify bird calls in Hawaiian soundscapes.

guide.zh: 背景声可能比目标鸟鸣更响，一段录音里也可能有多个鸟种。先听同一鸟种在不同背景下的片段，再查看时频图上短促叫声出现的位置。比较不同模型时，保留相同的切片边界与评估录音。
guide.en: A recording can contain several species, and the background may dominate a quiet call. Listen to the same species in different settings and locate the short calls on a spectrogram. Keep segment boundaries and evaluation recordings fixed when comparing detectors.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2023
competitions.summary: 识别肯尼亚野外录音中的鸟种。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify bird species in Kenyan field recordings.

guide.zh: 历届训练资料可能重复，同一声音出现在训练和验证两端会让分数看起来过好。先看每个物种有多少独立录音，再用同一划分比较两种模型。结合各物种成绩判断改动是否也帮助了少见鸟种。
guide.en: Recordings recur across collections. If a copy reaches both training and validation, the model can recognize the clip itself. Count independent recordings per species before comparing models on the same split, then inspect rare species separately.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2024
competitions.summary: 从连续录音中识别西高止山脉的鸟类。
competitions.summaryEN: Recognize bird species in continuous recordings from the Western Ghats.

guide.zh: 带标签的短录音往往能清楚听见目标鸟，连续声景里则有安静区间、远处鸟鸣和多种背景声。先比较两类音频的时长与能量分布，然后在固定验证折上分别记录常见与稀有鸟种的 AUC，再判断加入无标签声景是否值得。
guide.en: Labeled clips often foreground one bird. A continuous soundscape also contains quiet stretches, distant calls and overlapping sounds. Compare duration and signal energy across the two collections. On a fixed fold, inspect AUC by species before deciding whether unlabeled soundscapes help.

competitions.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb – Molecular Translation
competitions.summary: 从分子结构图预测对应的 InChI 字符串。
competitions.summaryEN: Transcribe a molecular structure image into its InChI string.

guide.zh: 模型接收图像，提交的是字符串。读错一个符号可能引入多个字符编辑。先把错误分成图像识别、字符串生成和候选排序三类，再用编辑距离比较改进，保留原图以便回查。
guide.en: The input is an image and the output is a string. A single misread symbol can require several character edits. Keep the image beside each prediction, label errors from visual recognition, sequence generation or reranking, and compare their edit distances.

competitions.title: Predicting Molecular Properties
competitions.summary: 利用分子结构预测原子对之间的标量耦合常数。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict scalar coupling constants for atom pairs from molecular structures.

guide.zh: 同一个分子里有多个待预测的原子对，它们共享结构背景。用分子而非单行划分本地验证，再按耦合类型分开统计绝对误差，可判断总分的变化主要来自哪一类原子对。
guide.en: Several target pairs can belong to the same molecule and share structural context. Hold out whole molecules in a local experiment. Break absolute errors down by coupling type to see which groups drive a change in the overall score.

competitions.title: Connect X
competitions.summary: 开发在棋盘上实现连续连子的对战策略。
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent that connects pieces in a line on a game board.

guide.zh: 每步落子同时改变自己的连线机会和对方的威胁。先用少量固定棋局测试能否发现一步获胜和必须防守的位置，再让智能体轮流执先、执后与同一对手对局，分别记录胜率。
guide.en: Each move affects both your winning lines and the opponent’s threats. Start with positions that have a forced win or a mandatory block. Then alternate which agent moves first against a fixed opponent and report results by starting side.

competitions.title: Contradictory, My Dear Watson
competitions.summary: 判断多语言句子对的蕴含、矛盾或中立关系。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify multilingual sentence pairs as entailment, contradiction or neutral.

guide.zh: 输入包含前提与假设，词语相似并不能确定逻辑关系。挑出词汇重合但标签不同的句对，观察否定、数量和指代。按语言查看混淆矩阵，可以发现整体准确率掩盖的弱点。
guide.en: The input is a premise and a hypothesis. Inspect pairs with overlapping vocabulary but different labels, especially those involving negation, quantities or references. Compare confusion matrices by language to find weaknesses hidden by overall accuracy.

competitions.title: Digit Recognizer
competitions.summary: 从 MNIST 图像识别手写数字。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify handwritten MNIST digits from their pixel values.

guide.zh: 每行像素需要按原顺序恢复成图像。先画出几张样本，确认方向和归一化一致，再查看最常互相混淆的两类数字。用同一验证集比较线性基线和卷积模型，保存错分样例。
guide.en: Restore each row of pixels to an image before modeling. Plot examples to verify orientation and scaling, then inspect the pair of digits your baseline confuses most often. Compare a linear classifier and a convolutional model on the same split.

competitions.title: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
competitions.summary: 根据质谱数据推断复杂提取物中小分子的二维化学结构。
competitions.summaryEN: Infer two-dimensional molecular structures from mass spectra of complex extracts.

guide.zh: 这是候选检索和排序问题。先检查正确结构是否进入候选集，再查看它被排到第几位。如果第一步失败，再好的重排模型也无从选中目标。分别记录候选覆盖率和平均精度有助于定位瓶颈。
guide.en: Treat candidate retrieval and ranking as separate stages. First check whether the correct structure enters the candidate set, then inspect its rank. Recording coverage alongside average precision tells you whether to improve retrieval or reranking.

competitions.title: Feedback Prize - English Language Learning
competitions.summary: 给英语学习者的作文预测六项写作能力分数。
competitions.metric: Mean Weighted Columnwise Root Mean Squared Error
competitions.summaryEN: Score English-language learners’ essays across six writing dimensions.

guide.zh: 同一篇作文有六个分数，各维度相关但误差可能不同。保留按作文划分的折外预测，为每个维度分别计算误差，再看加权总分。阅读融合方案时重点检查权重在哪些样本上学到。
guide.en: Each essay has six related scores. Keep out-of-fold predictions grouped by essay, calculate error per dimension, then inspect the weighted aggregate. When reading an ensemble, identify which essays were used to learn its weights.

competitions.title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition
competitions.summary: 围绕 Gemma 4 开发自主编程智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Build a software-development agent around Gemma 4.

guide.zh: 先选一道可在本地运行测试的编程题，记录初始代码、智能体提出的修改和测试输出。分别统计读题错误、修改错误及运行超时，再在相同预算下比较提示词或工具配置。
guide.en: Choose a programming task with local tests. Save the initial code, proposed patch and test output. Distinguish task misunderstandings, incorrect edits and timeouts before comparing prompts or tool configurations under the same budget.

competitions.title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track
competitions.summary: 用研究论文评估面向软件开发的智能体方法。
competitions.summaryEN: Evaluate a software-engineering agent approach in a research paper.

guide.zh: 阅读时先把论文的主张改写成可测量的问题，例如相同预算下通过多少道测试。核对基准、工具权限和停止条件，比较失败案例，最后检查论文赛道要求提交的证据。
guide.en: Turn the paper’s claim into a measurable question, such as tests passed under a fixed budget. Check the benchmark, available tools and stopping criteria. Compare failure cases and refer to the track rules for the evidence required.

competitions.title: Generalist Gaming Agent
competitions.summary: Build an agent that can play unfamiliar games
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent that can play unfamiliar games

competitions.title: Google Quantum AI - Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
competitions.summary: 在通过验证的前提下，减少量子应用所需的计算资源。
competitions.summaryEN: Reduce the resource cost of quantum circuits while preserving verifiable behavior.

guide.zh: 先区分两个目标：改写前后是否等价、通过验证后成本降低多少。保存一份基线电路，只替换一处门序列，比较资源计数并运行官方验证器。抽样模拟适合定位问题，接受条件以验证器为准。
guide.en: Separate correctness from cost. Save a baseline circuit, replace one gate sequence, compare resource counts and run the official verifier. Sample simulations help locate errors. Use the verifier’s acceptance criteria when interpreting the reported cost.

competitions.title: Housing Prices Competition for Kaggle Learn Users
competitions.summary: 用住宅属性预测房价，练习 Kaggle Learn 课程中的机器学习方法。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict home prices from property attributes in the Kaggle Learn exercise.

guide.zh: 可先只用面积和房间数训练小模型，把验证误差换算成平均相差多少成交金额。再添加一组分类特征，保持样本划分不变，并统计缺失值出现时的误差。
guide.en: Fit a small baseline using size and room counts. Interpret mean absolute error in sale-price units. Add one group of categorical features on the same split, then inspect errors on properties with missing attributes.

competitions.title: House Prices - Advanced Regression Techniques
competitions.summary: 根据房屋属性预测成交价，练习特征工程与回归。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict sale prices from residential property attributes.

guide.zh: 房价分布右侧往往有少数高价样本。比较原始价格和对数价格建模时，在同一组房屋上按官方指标评估，再把预测还原到金额查看误差。检查地段或价格档是否系统性偏高、偏低。
guide.en: Compare models trained on raw and log prices using the official metric on the same houses. Convert predictions back to currency as a second diagnostic. Break errors down by neighborhood or price band to find systematic over- or underestimation.

competitions.title: Image Matching Challenge 2023
competitions.summary: 从一组不同视角的照片恢复相机位姿。
competitions.summaryEN: Recover camera poses from images taken at different viewpoints.

guide.zh: 两幅图像有相似纹理，并不保证它们看到同一个三维点。先查看有重叠区域的图像对和局部匹配，再观察这些点在多个视角中的几何一致性。把未匹配成功和位姿估计错误分开分析。
guide.en: A similar texture in two views does not guarantee a shared 3D point. Inspect overlapping image pairs and their local matches, then check whether the matches agree across multiple cameras. Separate missing correspondences from pose-estimation errors.

competitions.title: Kaggriculture
competitions.summary: 在农场模拟游戏中开发智能体，与其他玩家竞争收入。
competitions.summaryEN: Build a farming-simulation agent that competes to earn income.

guide.zh: 行动的收益可能要等多个回合才会体现。先固定游戏种子和对手，以一个简单策略作为基线，记录不同阶段的收入和支出。比较策略时同时看最终收入和表现最差的对局。
guide.en: A decision may pay off several turns later. Fix game seeds and opponents, run a simple baseline policy, and track income and expenses by stage. Compare final income alongside the lowest-performing games.

competitions.title: LLM Classification Finetuning
competitions.summary: 根据 Chatbot Arena 对话预测人类对模型回答的偏好。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict human preferences between model responses in Chatbot Arena conversations.

guide.zh: 要输出的是相对偏好。先交换两份回答的顺序，检查预测能否相应交换，并留意平局样本。用对数损失检查概率质量，尤其关注模型很自信却判断错误的对话。
guide.en: Predict a relative preference. Swap the two responses to test whether the prediction swaps appropriately and inspect ties separately. Log loss makes confidently wrong predictions particularly important, so review those conversations directly.

competitions.title: NeurIPS 2024 - Lux AI Season 3
competitions.summary: 在部分可观测的网格游戏中训练对战智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Train an agent to compete in a partially observed grid game.

guide.zh: 当前画面只揭示部分地图，策略需要决定哪些历史观测仍然可信。比较只看当前帧与保留历史的两个基线，用同一组对手和种子测试，并按探索阶段和后期决策回看失误。
guide.en: Only part of the map is visible at each step. Compare a current-frame policy with one that retains past observations. Use identical seeds and opponents, then replay losses to distinguish exploration errors from late-game decisions.

competitions.title: Name That LLM
competitions.summary: 阅读一段生成文本，识别写下它的语言模型。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify the language model that wrote a given passage.

guide.zh: 同一家族的模型可能在词汇和标点上非常相似。按作者模型画混淆矩阵，区分跨家族和同家族错分。比较分类器时按类看召回率，避免发布样本较多的模型主导结论。
guide.en: Related models may have similar vocabulary and punctuation. Build a confusion matrix by author model and separate within-family from across-family errors. Inspect recall for each class alongside balanced accuracy.

competitions.title: NFL Big Data Bowl
competitions.summary: 从球员位置和运动信息预测一次冲球推进距离的概率分布。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict the distribution of rushing yards from player positions and motion.

guide.zh: 目标是每个码数阈值上的累计概率，一次冲球只有一个实际推进距离。先验证提交曲线单调且取值合法，再对照开球方向、阵形和场地边界。相同比赛的回合应放在同一验证组。
guide.en: Predict a cumulative probability for each yardage threshold. Check that each row is monotone and bounded, then inspect play direction, formation and field boundaries. Group plays from the same game when building a validation split.

competitions.title: NFL Big Data Bowl 2027
competitions.summary: 从球员测试的传感器轨迹中找出与 NFL 常规赛表现有关的信号。
competitions.summaryEN: Connect sensor traces from player assessments to regular-season NFL performance.

guide.zh: 先确定传感器序列对应哪位球员和哪次测试，再考虑用速度、变化率或时间窗口概括动作。把同一球员的数据放在同一侧，检查训练时使用的特征在预测常规赛表现时是否已经可见。
guide.en: Map each sensor sequence to its player and assessment before aggregating speed, changes or time windows. Split by player so repeated tests cannot appear on both sides. Check that each feature would be available when forecasting regular-season outcomes.

competitions.title: Natural Language Processing with Disaster Tweets
competitions.summary: 判断推文描述的是否为真实灾害。
competitions.summaryEN: Decide whether a tweet describes an actual disaster.

guide.zh: 包含灾害词汇的推文也可能是在开玩笑或使用比喻。用词袋分类器建立基线，再人工查看误报和漏报各一组。分别记录精确率与召回率，观察改变判定阈值后 F 分数如何变化。
guide.en: Disaster words also appear in jokes and metaphors. Build a bag-of-words baseline, then read a sample of false positives and false negatives. Track precision and recall separately while changing the classification threshold.

competitions.title: Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction
competitions.summary: 根据订单簿和成交记录预测短期波动率。
competitions.summaryEN: Forecast short-term realized volatility from order-book and trade records.

guide.zh: 同一股票在不同时间段有不同的交易活跃度。先按时间窗口整理订单簿和成交统计量，再用较早窗口训练、较晚窗口验证。比较邻居特征时，检查每个邻居在预测时点是否已经可见。
guide.en: Aggregate order-book and trade statistics within each time window. Fit on earlier periods and validate on later ones. If you add features from similar stocks or time windows, check that every neighbor would have been available at prediction time.

competitions.title: Google - Agent Harness on Physical-Engineering's Last Exam
competitions.summary: 构建能解决结构、土木、电气和机械工程题的智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent to solve structural, civil, electrical and mechanical engineering questions.

guide.zh: 先把题目中的已知量、要求量和单位整理成表，再用少量代表题检查输出格式、单位转换和推理过程。对比两个智能体时固定题集与工具预算，按错误类型统计，避免几道长题左右结论。
guide.en: List the givens, target variables and units for representative questions. Check answer format and dimensional consistency before comparing reasoning approaches. Use the same questions and tool budget, and group errors by type.

competitions.title: Predicting Airline Satisfaction
competitions.summary: 根据乘机体验相关特征预测旅客是否满意。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict airline passenger satisfaction from trip and service attributes.

guide.zh: 先检查评分字段的取值范围，区分缺失和低分。用简单分类器估计满意概率，在同一验证集上比较服务评分与行程特征各自的贡献，再看哪些旅客最容易被排错。
guide.en: Check rating scales and distinguish missing values from low scores. Start with a simple probability model, compare service ratings and trip attributes on the same holdout, and inspect which passengers are ranked incorrectly.

competitions.title: Predicting Credit Card Fraud
competitions.summary: 根据交易特征估计信用卡欺诈风险，并按风险对交易排序。
competitions.summaryEN: Rank transactions by their estimated risk of credit-card fraud.

guide.zh: 欺诈通常是少数类，把全部交易预测为正常也可能得到很高的准确率。先比较正常和欺诈交易的风险分数分布，再检查高风险区间里有多少真阳性。用 AUC 评价整体排序，也要查看接近阈值的错序样本。
guide.en: Fraud is a minority class, so a high accuracy can conceal a poor ranking. Plot scores for both classes and measure how many frauds reach the high-risk tail. Use AUC for ranking and inspect errors near an operational threshold.

competitions.title: Predicting Electric Vehicle Purchases
competitions.summary: 根据表格特征预测电动车购买倾向。
competitions.summaryEN: Rank customers by their likelihood of purchasing an electric vehicle.

guide.zh: 先训练一个简单概率模型，保留每个验证样本的预测。按得分从低到高分组，查看实际购买率是否随之上升。加入交互特征后，用相同样本比较排序变化与 AUC。
guide.en: Keep holdout probabilities from a simple baseline. Group examples by predicted score and check whether observed purchase rates rise across groups. Add interactions one at a time and compare changes in ranking and AUC on the same rows.

competitions.title: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection
competitions.summary: 使用多模态影像检测膝部异常。
competitions.summaryEN: Detect knee abnormalities from multimodal imaging data.

guide.zh: 同一检查可能提供多种视图或模态。先核对影像与标签的对应关系，按患者划分验证，避免同一人出现在两侧。比较单模态与多模态模型的错误类型，并检查缺失模态的样本。
guide.en: An examination may contain multiple views or modalities. Verify image-to-label alignment and group validation by patient. Compare error types for single- and multimodal models and inspect examinations with missing inputs.

competitions.title: Santa 2025 - Christmas Tree Packing Challenge
competitions.summary: 把给定数量的树形图块放入尽可能小的正方形。
competitions.summaryEN: Pack tree-shaped pieces into the smallest enclosing square.

guide.zh: 每个候选布局既要放得紧，也要通过无重叠的可行性检查。选小规模实例画出边界与接触位置，分别记录边长和重叠。比较搜索方法时固定运行时间，并统计多次运行的最好值和中位数。
guide.en: A compact layout still has to be feasible. Draw the boundary and contact points for small instances and report side length separately from overlap. Compare search methods under equal runtime using both best and median outcomes.

competitions.title: Santa 2026 - The Elf Calculator
competitions.summary: 从给定的小数值出发，用尽可能少的算术步骤构造目标整数。
competitions.summaryEN: Construct target integers from small starting values using as few arithmetic steps as possible.

guide.zh: 一个中间结果可能帮助构造多个后续数。先在小目标上记录每一步运算及其输入，重放序列检查合法性，再比较不同构造需要多少步。把无效表达式和有效但过长的序列分开处理。
guide.en: Intermediate results can be reused. For small targets, record each operation and its operands, replay the sequence to verify legality, then compare step counts. Separate invalid constructions from valid sequences that are merely long.

competitions.title: Santander Customer Transaction Prediction
competitions.summary: 在匿名表格特征上预测客户是否会进行交易。
competitions.metric: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve
competitions.summaryEN: Predict whether a customer will transact from anonymized numerical features.

guide.zh: 没有业务字段名时，可以先研究每列的分布、重复值和缺失模式。用同一验证划分比较原始数值与频次编码，明确计算频次时可访问哪些样本，之后再评估特征能否迁移。
guide.en: With anonymized columns, begin with distributions, repeated values and missingness. Compare raw values with frequency encodings on the same fold. State exactly which rows were available when computing counts before interpreting their transferability.

competitions.title: Spaceship Titanic
competitions.summary: 根据飞船乘客信息预测其是否被传送到另一维度。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict whether each fictional passenger was transported to another dimension.

guide.zh: 乘客可能属于同一旅行团，组内属性会相关。比较按行随机划分与按团分组划分的结果，检查舱位、消费和缺失字段。加入团体统计时，把统计量的计算限定在当前可见的信息内。
guide.en: Passengers can travel in groups. Compare a random row split with a group-aware split and inspect cabin, spending and missing-value fields. Compute group statistics only from information available at prediction time.

competitions.title: Squares in Squares
competitions.summary: 把指定数量的单位正方形排入尽可能小的正方形。
competitions.summaryEN: Pack a given number of unit squares inside the smallest possible square.

guide.zh: 平移和旋转会同时改变边界与碰撞约束。先在少量方块上验证几何判定，画出最接近重叠的两块。优化阶段分别记录可行率和最小外框边长，以免用无效布局产生看似更好的结果。
guide.en: Translations and rotations change boundary and collision constraints together. Test geometry checks on small cases and plot the closest pair of squares. Track feasibility and enclosing side length separately so an invalid arrangement cannot appear to improve the result.

competitions.title: Store Sales - Time Series Forecasting
competitions.summary: 使用历史记录预测零售门店的商品销售额。
competitions.summaryEN: Forecast retail sales across stores and product families from historical records.

guide.zh: 样本由日期、门店和商品类别共同标识。用向后滚动的窗口做本地验证，比较上一周同日销量与学习模型。加入滞后特征前，逐列检查其值只来自预测日期之前。
guide.en: Rows are indexed by date, store and product family. Use rolling time splits and compare a same-weekday baseline against a learned model. Check that every lag or rolling statistic uses only dates available at the forecast origin.

competitions.title: The Pokémon Company - PTCG AI Battle Challenge Playground
competitions.summary: 训练能够参与宝可梦卡牌对战的智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Train an agent to play Pokémon Trading Card Game battles.

guide.zh: 每个回合要在合法动作中选择，单局结果还受抽牌影响。先实现一个能完成整局的简单策略，再固定对手和种子比较不同决策。记录胜率时同时保留关键转折回合，便于解释改进。
guide.en: The policy selects from legal actions, and card draws add variance. Start with a policy that completes a game. Compare decisions against fixed opponents and seeds, and keep pivotal turns alongside win rates to explain differences.

competitions.title: Titanic - Machine Learning from Disaster
competitions.summary: 根据乘客资料预测其在泰坦尼克号事故中的生还情况。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict passenger survival from Titanic passenger records.

guide.zh: 从性别、年龄、舱位等字段建立简单生还概率基线，先检查年龄缺失集中在哪些群体。家庭成员或同票号乘客可能相关，试着按同行群体分组验证，再判断特征是否真的带来可迁移的增益。
guide.en: Start with survival probabilities from sex, age and class. Inspect which groups have missing ages. Family members or passengers sharing a ticket can be related, so try group-aware validation before trusting improvements from group features.

competitions.title: Petals to the Metal - Flower Classification on TPU
competitions.summary: 使用 TPU 训练花卉图像分类模型。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify flower photographs using models trained on a TPU.

guide.zh: 外观相似的花种可能只有局部纹理或花瓣形态不同。固定训练和验证图像，比较输入分辨率与裁剪方式。按类别查看误报和漏报，避免样本较多的花种掩盖宏平均 F 分数的变化。
guide.en: Similar flower species may differ only in local texture or petal shape. Keep the split fixed when comparing crop and resolution choices. Inspect false positives and negatives by species to understand changes in macro F-score.

lessons.title: 只在相近风险档里微调欺诈排序
lessons.summary: 把公开预测分成 40 个风险档。CatBoost 学到的分数先减去所在风险区间的典型水平，再以小权重调整原排序。这样能把精力放在难分先后的交易上。
lessons.takeaway: 固定基础预测，比较调整前后的 AUC 和平均名次移动，同时换一个划分检查稳定性。

steps.title: 重建对照组
steps.body: 从 `/kaggle/input` 查找五份预测文件，用文件名和各自的 SHA-256 锁定版本，再按 `sample_submission.csv` 的 `id` 顺序对齐 `is_fraud`。对每份预测计算 `logit((rankdata(values) - 0.5) / len(values))`，依次得到 `R`、`Q`、`P`、`O`、`F`。用最小二乘（`rcond=None`）将 `F-Q` 投影到由 `R-Q`、`Q-P`、`P-O` 组成的矩阵上，减去拟合值后得到 `residual`，再计算 `score = R + 0.35 * residual`。把 `score` 转回百分位排名，写入 `/kaggle/working/submission.csv`，并核对输出的 SHA-256。
steps.bodyEN: Find the five prediction files under `/kaggle/input`, pin each revision by filename and SHA-256, and align its `is_fraud` values to the `id` order in `sample_submission.csv`. Apply `logit((rankdata(values) - 0.5) / len(values))` to each prediction vector to obtain `R`, `Q`, `P`, `O`, and `F`, in that order. Use least squares (`rcond=None`) to regress `F-Q` on `R-Q`, `Q-P`, and `P-O`, subtract the fitted values to obtain `residual`, and compute `score = R + 0.35 * residual`. Convert `score` back to percentile ranks, write `/kaggle/working/submission.csv`, and verify its SHA-256.
steps.why: 这一步先复现固定的对照排序，供后续 CatBoost 修正使用。最小二乘残差保留了 `F-Q` 中无法由已有三组排序变化线性解释的部分。
steps.whyEN: This recreates a fixed control ranking for the later CatBoost correction. The least-squares residual retains the part of `F-Q` that the three existing rank shifts do not explain linearly.
steps.limit: 同名文件不能互换，必须匹配指定哈希；预测还须通过 `id` 唯一性、行数和有限值检查。输出哈希验证的是文件复现是否一致，原文没有单独验证残差加权的收益。
steps.limitEN: Files with the same name are not interchangeable: each must match its specified hash. The predictions must also pass the ID uniqueness, row count, and finiteness checks. The output hash verifies exact file reproduction; the source does not separately validate the benefit of residual weighting.
steps.titleEN: Rebuild the control

steps.title: 确定训练长度
steps.body: 读取官方 `train.csv` 和 `test.csv`，将 `is_fraud` 从训练特征中取出作为标签，并按样例提交的 `id` 和训练特征列对齐测试集。将非数值且非布尔列的缺失值填为 `'unknown'` 后转成字符串，再加入 `merchant_risk_score*velocity_score` 和 `cvv_retry_count*prior_disputes` 两个交互项。以标签分层切分，设置 `test_size=.2`、`random_state=79`；CatBoost 使用 `depth=7`、`learning_rate=.11`、`loss_function='Logloss'`、`eval_metric='AUC'`、`random_seed=79`、`cat_features=categories`、`thread_count=4`、`verbose=False` 和 `allow_writing_files=False`。试跑设 `iterations=300`、`early_stopping_rounds=35`，并根据留出集的正类概率计算 ROC-AUC。读取试跑模型的 `tree_count_`，以该值作为 `iterations`，用相同参数在全部训练数据上重训。
steps.bodyEN: Load the official `train.csv` and `test.csv`, remove `is_fraud` from the training features to use as the label, and align the test set to the sample submission IDs and training feature columns. Fill missing values in columns that are neither numeric nor Boolean with `'unknown'`, cast those columns to strings, and add the interactions `merchant_risk_score*velocity_score` and `cvv_retry_count*prior_disputes`. Stratify the split by label with `test_size=.2` and `random_state=79`; configure CatBoost with `depth=7`, `learning_rate=.11`, `loss_function='Logloss'`, `eval_metric='AUC'`, `random_seed=79`, `cat_features=categories`, `thread_count=4`, `verbose=False`, and `allow_writing_files=False`. Run the pilot with `iterations=300` and `early_stopping_rounds=35`, then compute ROC-AUC from the positive-class probabilities on the holdout. Set `iterations` to the pilot model's `tree_count_` and refit on all training data with the same parameters.
steps.why: 先用分层留出集选择树数，再用选定的树数在所有有标签的样本上拟合最终模型。
steps.whyEN: Use a stratified holdout to select the tree count, then train the final model with that tree count on all labeled rows.
steps.limit: 树数由一次固定种子的留出切分选出，不是交叉验证的结果。留出 AUC 只评估试跑的 CatBoost，原文没有报告这种选树方式或全量重训相对其他做法的收益。

steps.titleEN: Choose the number of trees

steps.title: 在风险档内调序
steps.body: 将全量重训模型输出的测试集正类概率转成对数几率排名 `tree_rank`，并把对照 `score` 转成百分位 `percentile`。用 `np.minimum((percentile*40).astype(int),39)` 划分风险档，计算各档内 `tree_rank` 的中位数，档中心设为 `(np.arange(40)+.5)/40`。在档中心之间对中位数做线性插值，并从 `tree_rank` 中减去插值结果以得到 `within_band`。按 `candidate = score+.035*np.clip(within_band,-.55,.55)` 修正对照分数，将候选分数重新排名并以 `(after-.5)/len(after)` 写出提交，同时记录变化的排名数和平均绝对排名移动。
steps.bodyEN: Convert the refitted model's positive-class test probabilities to logit ranks (`tree_rank`) and the control `score` to percentiles (`percentile`). Assign risk bands with `np.minimum((percentile*40).astype(int),39)`, compute the median `tree_rank` in each band, and set the band centers to `(np.arange(40)+.5)/40`. Linearly interpolate the medians across the band centers and subtract the interpolated value from `tree_rank` to obtain `within_band`. Apply `candidate = score+.035*np.clip(within_band,-.55,.55)`, rerank the candidate scores, and write `(after-.5)/len(after)` to the submission while logging the number of changed ranks and the mean absolute rank movement.
steps.why: 用同一对照风险水平下的 CatBoost 排名作为参照，提取局部相对信号，而不是直接用 CatBoost 替换全局排序。裁剪和小权重限制了对原分数的扰动。
steps.whyEN: Use the typical CatBoost rank at a similar control risk level as a reference, so the correction reflects a local signal rather than replacing the global ranking. Clipping and a small weight limit how much the original scores are perturbed.
steps.limit: 风险档用于估计局部参照，并非重排的硬边界：最终是全局重排，候选样本仍可能跨档换序。排名移动只表明预测发生了变化，原文没有报告这一步相对对照的 ROC-AUC 收益。
steps.limitEN: The bands define a local reference, not hard reranking boundaries: the final rerank is global, so rows can still swap order across bands. Rank movement shows only that predictions changed; the source does not report a ROC-AUC gain over the control for this step.
steps.titleEN: Adjust the ranking within risk bands

lessons.author: star
lessons.title: NTL 720 Sibling Odds 方法解析
lessons.summary: 任务是在生成文本分类竞赛中，通过集成多个基于不同语言模型的子模型预测结果，实现更准确地识别文本属于哪种语言模型。主要难点是测试集很大且资源有限，只有部分文本能被较慢但精准的模型处理，且某些模型家族间区分难度较大。方法动机是融合风格特征、生成模型评分和统计模型等多种视角，通过多阶段分段推理和样本选择，结合变体筛选决策规则，提升分类性能。
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to classify generated texts in a competition by identifying which language model produced them. The main challenge includes large test data with limited budget allowing only partial scoring by slower but more accurate models, and fine distinctions within model families. The method motivates integrating multiple perspectives such as stylistic features, generation model likelihoods, and statistical models in a multi-stage segmented inference pipeline, combined with variant filtering decision rules, to improve classification accuracy.
lessons.takeaway: 本方法通过设计复杂的多阶段推理流水线，实现了对大规模测试样本的高效筛选和多模型融合，尤重视模型家族内的‘兄弟模型’之间判断，通过调整概率增益和样式投票机制来修正决策，提升了细粒度分类结果的准确性。这对资源有限环境下的多分类任务尤其有借鉴意义。
lessons.takeawayEN: This approach uses a complex multi-stage inference pipeline to efficiently select and ensemble predictions on large test sets, emphasizing judgments among sibling models within the same family by adjusting likelihood gains and style votes to refine decisions. It significantly improves fine-grained classification accuracy and serves as a valuable reference for multi-class tasks under resource constraints.

steps.title: 输入与初步模型元数据准备
steps.titleEN: Input and Initial Model Metadata Preparation
steps.body: Cell 8 根据 `kernel-metadata.json` 核对声明的输入挂载，兼容两种挂载布局。`_SLUGS` 列出所需数据集，`_MODELS` 列出带版本的模型路径，`_OPTIONAL` 则用通配模式列出额外文件。可选文件的匹配数量只打印，不做断言；提交时走 `FAST_COMMIT`，不加载权重。
steps.bodyEN: Cell 8 checks that the sources declared in `kernel-metadata.json` are mounted, accepting either mount layout. `_SLUGS` lists the required datasets, `_MODELS` lists versioned model paths, and `_OPTIONAL` uses glob patterns to list extra files. Optional match counts are printed rather than asserted, and the commit takes the `FAST_COMMIT` path without loading weights.
steps.why: 在不加载权重的快速提交中，先发现评分重跑所需的输入是否缺失。
steps.whyEN: The checks catch missing scoring-rerun inputs during a fast commit without loading weights.
steps.limit: 挂载检查和下一单元的断言是提交时仅有的评分输入检查；它们不能证明权重可加载或完整推理能跑通。原文未报告这一步的分数收益。
steps.limitEN: The mount checks and the next cell’s assertions are the only commit-time checks of the scoring inputs; they do not establish that the weights load or that full inference runs successfully. No score gain is reported for this step.

steps.title: 两阶段分批GPU推理与特征提取
steps.titleEN: Two-stage Pipelined GPU Inference and Feature Extraction
steps.body: 共享的 `pipe.py` 调度器将各 reader 的推理任务拆成批次，分配到两张 T4 上。它让加载与计算重叠，遵守截止时间，并在批次失败时切换到回退路径。另列的 GSQ 特征读取器按 worker 交错分配文本，不截断分词结果，在末尾追加 `248044`，再分批生成 `40960` 维特征和 `18` 类分数。
steps.bodyEN: The shared `pipe.py` scheduler splits reader inference jobs into batches across two T4 GPUs. It overlaps loading with compute, honors a deadline, and switches to a fallback path when a batch fails. The separately documented GSQ feature reader interleaves text rows across workers, tokenizes without truncation, appends `248044`, and produces `40960`-dimensional features and `18` class scores in batches.
steps.why: 调度器让加载和计算并行进行，并在单批失败时提供回退路径，使 reader 能在时间预算内执行。
steps.whyEN: The scheduler overlaps loading with computation and provides a fallback for failed batches so the readers can operate within their time budget.
steps.limit: Cell 15 没有给出固定批大小，也没有定义两套依次执行的推理模型。GSQ 不会截断超长文本，而是断言追加标记后的序列未超出上下文。原文未单独报告调度的速度或准确率收益。
steps.limitEN: Cell 15 does not specify a fixed batch size or define two inference models run in sequence. GSQ does not truncate overlong text; it asserts that the sequence still fits the context after the marker is appended. No standalone speed or accuracy gain is reported for the scheduler.

steps.title: 核心投票与风格特征结合预测
steps.titleEN: Core Voting and Integration of Style Features in Prediction
steps.body: `ntl660_readout.py` 读取预拟合 SVC 池中的 `svc4`、`tfidf` 和 `distort`。它从每段文本的外形和功能词两个视角读取投票。实际混合设置为 `--svc_w 0 --tfidf_w 0 --distort_w 0`，所以这三路投票不影响预测，但提交运行仍会对它们做冒烟测试。
steps.bodyEN: `ntl660_readout.py` reads `svc4`, `tfidf`, and `distort` from the pre-fit SVC pool. It reads votes from two views of each passage: its shape and its function words. The blend sets `--svc_w 0 --tfidf_w 0 --distort_w 0`, so these votes do not affect predictions, but the commit still smoke-tests them.
steps.why: 即使正式混合禁用了这三路投票，冒烟测试仍能尽早发现预拟合池是否损坏。
steps.whyEN: The smoke test catches a broken pre-fit pool early even though the three votes are disabled in the actual blend.
steps.limit: 不要把两种风格视角误读为这三路投票对最终预测有非零贡献；原文未报告开启它们的收益。
steps.limitEN: Do not interpret the two style views as a nonzero contribution from these three votes to the final predictions. The source does not report a gain from enabling them.

steps.title: 兄弟模型间的后验决策规则应用
steps.titleEN: Application of Posterior Decision Rules Among Sibling Models
steps.body: `prefix_decisions.py` 对有似然结果的行比较基础分数 `base` 和后验分数 `post`。`fable_return` 只在基础首选是两种 GLM 之一、后验首选变为 `claude-fable-5` 时放行，并要求 Fable 相对较高 GLM 分数的优势至少增加 `.30`、更新后至少为 `.25`。`sibling_agreement` 则要求后验首选不同于基础首选，且正好是 `refined` 的第二名。只有当 `refined` 的前两名同属 `claude`、`gpt` 或 `gemini`、分差不超过 `np.log(2.)`，并且风格头也把后验首选排为该家族首选时，规则才会放行。
steps.bodyEN: `prefix_decisions.py` compares the base scores (`base`) with the posterior scores (`post`) for rows with likelihood results. `fable_return` only accepts a switch from either GLM class to `claude-fable-5`, and only if Fable’s margin over the higher-scoring GLM increases by at least `.30` and reaches at least `.25` after the update. `sibling_agreement` requires the posterior winner to differ from the base winner and to be exactly the runner-up in `refined`. It only accepts the change when the top two in `refined` share a `claude`, `gpt`, or `gemini` family, their gap is at most `np.log(2.)`, and the style head also picks the posterior winner as its top sibling.
steps.why: 把似然修正限制在有额外证据支持的近距离同族决策上，同时为从 GLM 改判到 Fable 保留一条单独的保护规则。
steps.whyEN: The rules restrict likelihood-driven changes to close sibling decisions with corroborating evidence, while preserving a separate guarded route from GLM to Fable.
steps.limit: 复现时不能把 `base` 的首选、`post` 的首选和 `refined` 的前两名混用；它们承担不同的判定条件。原文未单独验证这两个门控规则的收益。
steps.limitEN: Keep the `base` winner, the `post` winner, and the top two in `refined` distinct when reproducing the rules; each serves a different condition. No separate benefit is reported for either gate.

steps.title: 分级测试样本调度与部分覆盖机制
steps.titleEN: Hierarchical Test Sample Scheduling and Partial Coverage Mechanism
steps.body: S10 写出提交文件和 `final-logits.npz` 后，似然阶段按 S10 对 `--select-classes` 中两种 GLM 类别的概率质量给测试文本排序。它从队首开始评分，覆盖率受剩余时间和 `--max-cover` 共同限制；若能处理的文本少于 `--min-texts`，则保留 S10 的提交。每个模型有硬时间预算，`--prefetch` 可在计算当前分段时读取下一分段。若 Flash 比预计更慢，GLM-5.3 只处理剩余时间内排在最前、且仍满足 `--min-texts` 的文本，混合也只使用这些文本。
steps.bodyEN: After S10 writes its submission and `final-logits.npz`, the likelihood stage ranks test passages by S10’s probability mass for the two GLM classes named in `--select-classes`. It scores from the top of the queue, capped by both the remaining time and `--max-cover`; if fewer than `--min-texts` fit, it keeps the S10 submission. Each model has a hard time budget, and `--prefetch` can read the next segment while the current one computes. If Flash runs longer than estimated, GLM-5.3 scores only the highest-ranked rows that still fit, provided they meet `--min-texts`, and the blend uses only those rows.
steps.why: S10 之后的剩余时间不足以覆盖整个测试集，作者报告整套处理约为 4,000 篇文本耗时 6.7 小时。似然模型的收益几乎都来自区分 glm-5.3 和 glm-5.3-flash，因此先处理这两类概率质量较高的文本。
steps.whyEN: The full test set does not fit in the time left after S10; the reported estimate is roughly 6.7 hours for 4,000 passages. Nearly all of the likelihood member’s gain comes from distinguishing glm-5.3 from glm-5.3-flash, so rows with high probability mass for those classes go first.
steps.limit: 实际覆盖率取决于剩余时间和两个模型的运行速度，并不等于 `--max-cover`。原文的覆盖率对照来自训练集折外结果，不能据此确定测试集的最佳覆盖率。
steps.limitEN: Actual coverage depends on the remaining time and the two models’ runtimes; it need not reach `--max-cover`. The reported coverage comparison uses training out-of-fold results and does not establish the best test-set coverage.

lessons.author: Emmanuel Mireku Mensah
lessons.title: 识别文本背后的语言模型：从集成预测到 GLM 与 Fable 纠错
lessons.summary: 任务是判断一段 40–250 词的文本由 18 个语言模型中的哪一个生成，评价指标是各类别召回率的平均值，即平衡准确率。按提示词分组的折外预测显示，Fable 和两个 GLM 类别的召回率偏低，因此笔记本在基础集成之外增加了针对性的似然复判。由于推理预算不足以复判所有文本，流程优先处理已有 Fable 倾向的候选，并用一道保护规则避免末轮重判撤销证据较强的 Fable 翻转。附件提到最终版本还加入了 Sibling Odds，但没有给出足以复现该规则的细节。
lessons.takeaway: 预算有限时，先决定哪些文本值得复判，再决定哪些翻转值得保留。要判断某条规则是否有效，应固定候选行、分数和其他后处理，只切换这一条规则，而不是把不同重跑的分差当作消融结果。

steps.title: 配置基础集成推理
steps.titleEN: Configure base ensemble inference
steps.body: 将 `DATA`、序列化后的 `MODELS` 和 `PREFIT` 分别通过 `--data`、`--models` 和 `--prefit_core` 传给 `infer.py`。将 `--tfidf_w`、`--distort_w` 和 `--svc_w` 均设为 `0`，将 `--adapt_w` 和 `--adapt_thr` 分别设为 `1.0` 和 `0.15`。同时传入 `--sinkhorn 0.30`、`--sinkhorn_target_mix 0.35` 和 `--group_sim 0.70`，并在命令配置中将输出路径设为 `/kaggle/working/submission.parquet`。
steps.bodyEN: Pass `DATA`, the serialized `MODELS` list, and `PREFIT` to `infer.py` via `--data`, `--models`, and `--prefit_core`, respectively. Set `--tfidf_w`, `--distort_w`, and `--svc_w` to `0`, and set `--adapt_w` and `--adapt_thr` to `1.0` and `0.15`, respectively. Also pass `--sinkhorn 0.30`, `--sinkhorn_target_mix 0.35`, and `--group_sim 0.70`, and set the command's output path to `/kaggle/working/submission.parquet`.
steps.why: 先生成面向全部类别的基础预测，再由专门的似然阶段复判部分候选。
steps.whyEN: Produce baseline predictions for all classes before a dedicated likelihood stage revisits a subset of candidates.
steps.limit: 这段命令依赖前面定义的模型和预拟合资产；附件没有单独验证这些参数各自的收益。
steps.limitEN: The command depends on previously defined models and prefitted assets. The excerpt does not isolate the benefit of any of these settings.

steps.title: 在固定预算下重排 GLM 复判队列
steps.titleEN: Rerank the GLM scoring queue under a fixed budget
steps.body: 以基础集成的混合概率质量 `mass` 作为候选行的原始优先级。从集成结果中取 Fable 的概率质量 `fable_mass`，给原优先级加上 `0.35 * min(fable_mass, mass)`。按调整后的优先级安排 GLM 似然计算；单行优先级最多提高到原来的 1.35 倍，复判预算不变。
steps.bodyEN: Start with the base ensemble's blended probability mass, `mass`, as each candidate row's priority. Take the ensemble's Fable probability mass, `fable_mass`, and add `0.35 * min(fable_mass, mass)` to the original priority. Use the adjusted priorities to schedule GLM likelihood scoring: a row's priority can rise to at most 1.35 times its original value, while the scoring budget stays fixed.
steps.why: 按提示词分组的折外结果显示 Fable 和两个 GLM 类别召回率偏低；重排让已有 Fable 倾向的候选更可能进入有限的复判名额。
steps.whyEN: Prompt-grouped out-of-fold results showed low recall for Fable and both GLM classes. The reranking makes candidates with existing Fable support more likely to receive one of the limited rescoring slots.
steps.limit: 折外召回率用于诊断弱项，不是这项重排的消融结果；附件未单独验证重排的收益。
steps.limitEN: The out-of-fold recalls diagnose weak classes; they are not an ablation of the reranking rule. The excerpt does not isolate its benefit.

steps.title: 设置双 GLM 似然阶段的截止时间
steps.titleEN: Set a deadline for the two-model GLM likelihood stage
steps.body: 以 `DATA` 下的 `test.csv` 为测试输入，启用 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 GLM-5.3 的似然阶段，并用 `KAGGLE_IS_COMPETITION_RERUN` 判断是否为评分重跑。将 `V1_DEADLINE_H` 设为 `8.8`，低于笔记本的 9 小时上限。将 `V1_ROBUST` 设为 `True`，使用 `--priority-order --shrink`；将 `V1_PACK, V1_UBATCH_DIV, V1_SEQ_BATCH, V1_PREFETCH` 依次设为 `False, 1, 8, False`。
steps.bodyEN: Use `test.csv` under `DATA` as the test input, enable the GLM-5.3-Flash and GLM-5.3 likelihood stage, and use `KAGGLE_IS_COMPETITION_RERUN` to detect a scoring rerun. Set `V1_DEADLINE_H` to `8.8`, below the notebook's 9-hour limit. Set `V1_ROBUST` to `True` to use `--priority-order --shrink`, and set `V1_PACK, V1_UBATCH_DIV, V1_SEQ_BATCH, V1_PREFETCH` to `False, 1, 8, False`, respectively.
steps.why: 如果模型运行偏慢，按优先级缩小候选集可以保留排在前面的文本，而不是丢掉整个似然阶段。
steps.whyEN: If a model runs slowly, shrinking the candidate set in priority order preserves the highest-priority passages rather than losing the entire likelihood stage.
steps.limit: 成本估计来自原运行硬件，不能直接当作其他环境的吞吐保证；原文没有单独报告这些设置对平衡准确率的影响。
steps.limitEN: The cost estimates were measured on the original hardware and do not guarantee throughput elsewhere. The source does not report a separate balanced-accuracy effect for these settings.

steps.title: 保护证据较强的 GLM → Fable 翻转
steps.titleEN: Protect well-supported GLM-to-Fable flips
steps.body: 只检查基础集成预测为 GLM、而似然阶段将 `claude-fable-5` 推到第一位的行。比较复判前后 Fable 相对两个 GLM 类别中较强者的 logit 优势。只有优势至少增加 `0.30` logit，且复判后达到 `0.25` logit 或更高时，才通过 `fable_return` 保留 Fable 预测，不在末轮重新判定。
steps.bodyEN: Check only rows that the base ensemble labeled GLM and that the likelihood stage moved to `claude-fable-5` in first place. Compare Fable's logit lead over the stronger of the two GLM classes before and after likelihood scoring. Use `fable_return` to keep the Fable prediction without re-deciding it in the final pass only if the lead grows by at least `0.30` logit and finishes at `0.25` logit or higher.
steps.why: 末轮会用似然阶段之前的分数重判当前标签非 GLM 的行，因而可能把刚翻到 Fable 的文本改回 GLM。保护规则让证据较强的翻转保留下来。
steps.whyEN: The final pass re-decides rows currently labeled non-GLM from pre-likelihood scores, so it can send a newly flipped Fable prediction back to GLM. The guard preserves flips with stronger evidence.
steps.limit: 这不是通用的 Fable 提权规则：它不适用于未被似然阶段翻到 Fable 的行。原文没有测出该规则的独立收益。
steps.limitEN: This is not a general Fable boost: it does not apply to rows that the likelihood stage did not flip to Fable. The source does not measure the guard's standalone gain.

steps.title: 核验实际评分的提交文件
steps.titleEN: Audit the submission file that is actually scored
steps.body: 读取 `submission.parquet`，检查列恰为 `id, model`、ID 唯一且顺序与 `test.csv` 一致，并检查标签均属于 18 个候选类别。将行数和文件的 SHA-256 写入 `variant-proof.json`。随后读取该记录，断言行数和两列符合要求，再把同一 SHA-256 写入 `final_verification.json`。
steps.bodyEN: Read `submission.parquet` and check that its columns are exactly `id, model`, that IDs are unique and in the same order as `test.csv`, and that every label is one of the 18 allowed classes. Write the row count and the file's SHA-256 to `variant-proof.json`. Then read that record back, assert the row count and the two columns, and write the same SHA-256 to `final_verification.json`.
steps.why: 核验文件结构和行对齐，并留下可用于确认评分文件身份的记录。
steps.whyEN: Verify the file structure and row alignment, and leave a record that identifies the scored artifact.
steps.limit: 结构检查和哈希不能验证预测是否正确，也不能说明平衡准确率有所提升。
steps.limitEN: Schema checks and hashes cannot establish that predictions are correct or that balanced accuracy improved.

lessons.titleEN: Identifying the Language Model Behind a Passage: From Ensemble Predictions to GLM–Fable Corrections
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to identify which of 18 language models generated a 40–250-word passage, using balanced accuracy, the mean recall across classes. Prompt-grouped out-of-fold predictions showed low recall for Fable and both GLM classes, motivating a targeted likelihood pass after the base ensemble. Because the inference budget cannot cover every passage, the pipeline prioritizes candidates that already have some Fable support and uses a guard to keep the final pass from undoing well-supported flips to Fable. The excerpt mentions that the final version also adds Sibling Odds, but does not provide enough detail to reproduce that rule.
lessons.takeawayEN: Under a tight budget, first decide which passages deserve rescoring, then decide which flips deserve to survive. To test a rule, hold the candidate rows, scores, and other post-processing fixed and toggle only that rule rather than treating gaps between separate reruns as ablation results.

exercise.zh: 建议实验：如果能在带标签的数据上生成按提示词分组的折外预测，缓存基础集成 logits、似然复判后的 logits 和实际复判行。固定这些输入及其余后处理，分别开启和关闭 `fable_return`。比较平衡准确率、Fable 和两个 GLM 类别的召回率，并在发生翻转的行中检查保留了多少正确翻转、又保留了多少错误翻转。
exercise.en: Suggested experiment: If you can generate prompt-grouped out-of-fold predictions on labeled data, cache the base-ensemble logits, post-likelihood logits, and the rows actually rescored. Hold these inputs and all other post-processing fixed, and run once with `fable_return` enabled and once with it disabled. Compare balanced accuracy and recall for Fable and both GLM classes, then inspect the flipped rows to count how many correct and incorrect flips the guard preserved.

findings.claim: 同一流程的两次隐藏测试评分分别为 0.720 和 0.721。原文将 0.001 的差异归为运行间波动，而非代码改动。
findings.claimEN: Two hidden-test runs of the same pipeline scored 0.720 and 0.721. The source attributes the 0.001 difference to run-to-run variation rather than a code change.

findings.setupEN: All 29 code cells matched byte for byte and in order. Both runs attached the same 46 inputs and used GPU T4 x2 with internet access disabled.
findings.caveat: 原文估计隐藏测试评分的运行间波动约为 ±0.001。

findings.setup: 比较早期参考流程与带保护规则的 V3 的独立重跑，使用同一竞赛指标；原文未报告固定其他设置、只切换保护规则的对照。

findings.caveat: 测试集无公开标签，运行间波动约为 ±0.001；保护规则的独立贡献未测量。

lessons.author: Raja Rajak
lessons.title: 从质谱到分子结构：先补候选，再分段重排
lessons.summary: 这项竞赛要求根据复杂提取物中的质谱数据，为每个小分子给出按可能性排序的二维结构候选。前体质量能缩小分子式范围，却不能区分同分异构体；如果正确结构根本不在候选池中，重排也无法找回它。笔记本用质量先验、相似谱图之间的证据传播和外部谱库匹配来调整排序，并让学习式碎片重排器只调整第 3–25 位。它还在主流程之后用预测指纹为候选池结构的单步衍生物打分，以补充原有候选。
lessons.takeaway: 先区分正确结构是没进入候选池，还是已经入池但排得太低：前者需要补候选，后者才需要重排。锁定前两位，可以检验尾部重排，而不把首位变化混进结果。

steps.title: 用前体质量压低分子式不符的候选
steps.titleEN: Penalize Candidates with Inconsistent Precursor Masses
steps.body: 从 `test.parquet` 读取每张谱图的前体 m/z 和加合物，使用测定 timsTOF 误差带时的同一套常数换算中性质量。对同一分子的多张谱图取中性质量中位数，再计算各候选相对于该值的质量误差。在最终层对第 2–25 位应用质量惩罚：误差偏离 `MASS_CENTER` 超过 `MASS_FREE` ppm 后扣分，在 `MASS_FULL` ppm 时达到最大扣分 `MASS_W`；首位规则另行处理。
steps.bodyEN: Read each spectrum’s precursor m/z and adduct from `test.parquet`, then convert to neutral mass using the same constants used to measure the timsTOF error band. Take the median neutral mass across spectra for each molecule and calculate each candidate’s mass error against it. In the final layer, penalize ranks 2–25 when the error deviates from `MASS_CENTER` by more than `MASS_FREE` ppm, reaching the full penalty `MASS_W` at `MASS_FULL` ppm; handle the rank-1 rule separately.
steps.why: 把仪器质量精度转化为排序信号，压低质量不符的候选，而不把这项信号误当成同分异构体之间的结构证据。
steps.whyEN: Use instrument mass accuracy to down-rank inconsistent candidates without treating it as structural evidence that can distinguish isomers.
steps.limit: 同分异构体共享质量；该块没有给出这些常量的具体值，也没有报告此层的独立收益。
steps.limitEN: Isomers share the same mass. The block gives neither the numeric values of these constants nor a standalone result for this layer.

steps.title: 在相似谱图之间传播候选证据
steps.titleEN: Propagate Candidate Evidence Between Similar Spectra
steps.body: 在外部谱库覆盖之前，用谱图相似的测试分子构建邻居网络，共享候选证据；基础网络使用 `lambda 0.35`。D-L1 变体加入来自 `train.parquet` 的已知结构节点，并使用基于质量差的边权。它执行两步传播，同时保留上一个网络版本的首位候选。
steps.bodyEN: Before the external-library overlay, build a neighbor network of test molecules with similar spectra so they can share candidate evidence; the basic network uses `lambda 0.35`. The D-L1 variant adds nodes with known structures from `train.parquet` and uses mass-difference edge weights. It performs two propagation steps while retaining the preceding network version’s rank-1 candidate.
steps.why: 让相似谱图为各自的候选提供补充证据，同时避免 D-L1 的传播直接替换上一版本的首选。
steps.whyEN: Let similar spectra contribute evidence to one another’s candidate lists without allowing D-L1 propagation to directly replace the preceding version’s top choice.
steps.limit: 报告比较的是整套网络变体，不能分离已知结构节点、边权和传播步数各自的贡献。
steps.limitEN: The reported comparison tests the network variant as a bundle; it does not isolate the effects of known-structure nodes, edge weights, or propagation depth.

steps.title: 将高置信度的谱库直匹配提升至首位
steps.titleEN: Promote High-Confidence Direct Library Matches to Rank 1
steps.body: 将测试 MS/MS 谱图与外部实测参考谱图比对。直匹配要求前体质量误差 `<= 10 ppm`、离子模式相同、平方根强度余弦相似度 `>= 0.85`，且匹配峰数 `>= 4`。满足条件的参考结构可提升到第 1 位；若已有匹配满足 `lib_max >= LIB_TAU`，则保护原排序。
steps.bodyEN: Compare test MS/MS spectra with experimentally measured external reference spectra. A direct hit requires precursor mass error `<= 10 ppm`, the same ion mode, square-root intensity cosine similarity `>= 0.85`, and `>= 4` matched peaks. A qualifying reference structure can be promoted to rank 1, but the existing order is protected if it already has a match satisfying `lib_max >= LIB_TAU`.
steps.why: 让高置信度的实测谱图匹配直接影响首位选择，同时避免覆盖已有强匹配。
steps.whyEN: Let high-confidence measured-spectrum matches directly inform the top choice without overriding an existing strong match.
steps.limit: 这条规则依赖参考库覆盖率；该块没有给出 `LIB_TAU` 的具体值，也没有验证这些匹配门槛各自的收益。
steps.limitEN: The rule depends on reference-library coverage. The block does not give the numeric value of `LIB_TAU` or validate the contribution of each matching threshold.

steps.title: 先用 P5 补候选，再用 FR 重排第 3–25 位
steps.titleEN: Recover Candidates with P5, Then Rerank Positions 3–25 with FR
steps.body: P5 更换父候选顺序后重跑 Engine 1，只将新生成的候选插入第 3–25 位。此版本把学习式碎片重排移到 P5 之后，使新插入的候选也能参与打分。FR 在整张候选表上做 z 标准化，再以 `-rank + W * z` 为键稳定重排第 3 位及之后的候选，其中 `W = 3.0`，未打分候选的 `z` 为 0。FR 锁定前两位，不增删候选。
steps.bodyEN: P5 reruns Engine 1 with a different parent order and inserts only newly generated candidates into ranks 3–25. This version moves the learned fragment reranker after P5 so the inserted candidates are scored as well. FR z-standardizes scores across the entire list, then stably reranks candidates from rank 3 onward using `-rank + W * z`, with `W = 3.0` and `z` set to 0 for unscored candidates. FR locks the top two positions and neither adds nor drops candidates.
steps.why: P5 扩充尾部的候选覆盖，FR 再用碎片证据决定尾部顺序，同时不改动前两位。
steps.whyEN: P5 broadens candidate coverage in the tail, and FR then uses fragment evidence to reorder that tail without disturbing the top two positions.
steps.limit: 标准化范围是整张表，而不是仅第 3–25 位。把 FR 移到 P5 之后的收益未单独验证；会话运行超过 `8.2` 小时后，该重排会被跳过。
steps.limitEN: Standardization covers the entire list, not just ranks 3–25. The benefit of moving FR after P5 was not tested separately, and this reranking pass is skipped after `8.2` hours of session runtime.

steps.title: 用预测指纹筛选虚拟天然产物候选
steps.titleEN: Screen Virtual Natural-Product Candidates with Predicted Fingerprints
steps.body: 主流程结束后，将候选池结构的单步衍生物作为补充候选，用预测分子指纹打分，再合并到最终答案列表。合并规则为 `{'mode': 'score', 'c': 1.0, 'c1': 1.5, 'pmin': 1, 'kmax': 10, 'strat': 'notrestpos', 'fill': [3, 8], 'cmp1': True}`。运行预算为 `BUDGET_S = 6000`，两个神经模型权重分别为 `0.125` 和 `0.375`，另外设置 `W_TF = 0`、`W_NP = 0`、`W_LP = 0.25`。
steps.bodyEN: After the main pipeline, use single-step derivatives of candidate-pool structures as additional candidates, score them against predicted molecular fingerprints, and merge them into the final lists. The merge rule is `{'mode': 'score', 'c': 1.0, 'c1': 1.5, 'pmin': 1, 'kmax': 10, 'strat': 'notrestpos', 'fill': [3, 8], 'cmp1': True}`. The runtime budget is `BUDGET_S = 6000`, the two neural model weights are `0.125` and `0.375`, and the other settings are `W_TF = 0`, `W_NP = 0`, and `W_LP = 0.25`.
steps.why: 原候选池不含正确结构时，单靠重排无济于事；单步衍生物提供额外的搜索空间，预测指纹则用于筛选。
steps.whyEN: Reranking alone cannot help when the correct structure is missing from the original pool. Single-step derivatives expand the search space, and predicted fingerprints provide a way to screen them.
steps.limit: 评分重跑失败时保留主流程输出；提交时用 12 个可见分子做冒烟测试，失败则报错。该块没有报告固定其余流程、只开关虚拟层的对照。
steps.limitEN: A failure during the scoring rerun preserves the main pipeline output; a commit smoke test uses 12 visible molecules and raises on failure. The block does not report a controlled comparison that toggles only the virtual tier.

llmReview.reason: 该笔记本虽大量依赖导入的提交和榜单分数，但仍披露了可检查、可复用的方法：基于MetFrag-lite裂解枚举与中性丢失SMARTS匹配的谱-候选特征构造及候选内中心化学习重排序（证据19），以及仅对第3-25名按z分数加权的锁定式重排流程和失败回退（证据30），另有可追溯的重排设计说明（证据29）。这些步骤能让读者追踪特征构造、排序约束与回退的建模决策，满足至少两个可解释步骤的要求。

lessons.titleEN: From Mass Spectra to Molecular Structures: Recover Candidates, Then Rerank by Position
lessons.summaryEN: The competition asks for a ranked list of candidate 2D structures for each small molecule in a complex extract, using its mass spectra. Precursor mass can narrow down the molecular formula but cannot distinguish isomers, and reranking cannot recover a correct structure that is absent from the candidate pool. The notebook adjusts rankings with a mass prior, evidence propagation between similar spectra, and external spectral-library matches, while restricting the learned fragment reranker to ranks 3–25. After the main pipeline, it also uses predicted fingerprints to score single-step derivatives of candidate-pool structures and supplement the existing lists.
lessons.takeawayEN: First distinguish between a correct structure that never entered the candidate pool and one that entered but ranked too low. The former calls for candidate recovery; the latter calls for reranking. Locking the top two positions lets you test tail reranking without mixing in changes at the top.

exercise.zh: 在有真值的留出分子上，保存 P5 之前、P5 之后和 FR 之后的三份候选表，固定其他阶段。先比较 P5 前后正确结构进入前 25 位的分子数，再用 `W = 3.0` 运行 FR，确认每个分子的前两位和候选集合不变，并比较正确结构在第 3–25 位内上移、下移和不变的次数。
exercise.en: On held-out molecules with known structures, save three candidate lists: before P5, after P5, and after FR, holding other stages fixed. First compare how many molecules have the correct structure in the top 25 before and after P5. Then run FR with `W = 3.0`, verify that each molecule’s top two positions and candidate set are unchanged, and count how often the correct structure moves up, moves down, or stays put within ranks 3–25.

findings.claim: 在基础笔记本记录的逐项叠加实验中，仅更换谱库未改变公开 MRR@25（`0.487`）；随后加入 FR、P5、邻居网络和 D-L1，依次得到 `0.488`、`0.490`、`0.494` 和 `0.495`。
findings.claimEN: In the base notebook’s cumulative experiments, replacing only the spectral library left public MRR@25 unchanged at `0.487`. The subsequent FR, P5, neighbor-network, and D-L1 stages scored `0.488`, `0.490`, `0.494`, and `0.495`, respectively.
findings.setup: 从逐字节一致的基础版本开始，每次在上一行的版本上添加或替换表中指定的改动。这是固定顺序的累积比较，不是对最终虚拟候选版本逐层做消融。
findings.setupEN: Starting from a byte-identical base version, each submission adds or replaces the specified component relative to the preceding row. This is a fixed-order cumulative comparison, not a layer-by-layer ablation of the final virtual-candidate version.
findings.caveat: 公开评估约覆盖测试集的 30%，约 125 个分子；原文提醒 `0.001` 的差异可能落在噪声范围内。
findings.caveatEN: The public evaluation covers about 30% of the test set, roughly 125 molecules. The source cautions that a difference of `0.001` can fall within noise.

findings.claim: 在较早的基础流程实验中，启用和禁用来源感知重排的公开分数均为 `0.472`。
findings.claimEN: In an earlier base-pipeline experiment, enabling or disabling provenance reranking gave the same reported public score of `0.472`.
findings.setup: 比较 e1 和 e2：两者的第 2–25 位权重均为 `0.75`，使用同一个 v1 神经模型，并在 `0.75` 顺序上运行碎片检查；表中只切换来源感知重排。
findings.setupEN: Compare e1 and e2: both use a ranks 2–25 weight of `0.75`, the same v1 neural model, and fragment checking on the `0.75` order. Only provenance reranking changes in the table.
findings.caveat: 公开子集估计约有 125–130 个分子，分数只显示三位小数；同分不代表两份排序完全相同。
findings.caveatEN: The public subset was estimated at about 125–130 molecules and scores are displayed to three decimal places; equal scores do not imply identical rankings.

findings.claim: 在较早的基础流程中，加入权重为 2 的 NX 同分异构体重排后，公开分数从 `0.472` 降至 `0.414`。
findings.claimEN: In the earlier base pipeline, adding the NX isomer reranker at weight 2 lowered the reported public score from `0.472` to `0.414`.
findings.setup: 比较 e1 和 e6：两者均用同一个 v1 神经模型和第 2–25 位权重 `0.75`，在 `0.75` 顺序上运行碎片检查，且关闭来源感知重排；e6 额外加入 NX。
findings.setupEN: Compare e1 and e6: both use the same v1 neural model and ranks 2–25 weight of `0.75`, run fragment checking on the `0.75` order, and leave provenance reranking off. The e6 run adds NX.
findings.caveat: 只报告了这一配置下的结果；公开子集估计约有 125–130 个分子。
findings.caveatEN: Only this configuration is reported, on a public subset estimated at about 125–130 molecules.

lessons.author: ADITYA RAJ
lessons.title: 从质谱到分子结构：扩充候选，再用质量与加合物证据重排
lessons.summary: 任务是根据复杂提取物的质谱数据推断小分子的二维结构，并为每个分子提交一份有序候选列表。难点有两个：真实结构可能根本不在候选列表里，也可能因为辅助证据不够可靠而被排到后面。笔记本先利用正负离子模式的前体质量约束已有候选，再用 P5 Tail 补入可由已知化学变换生成的新结构，并让片段图评分器评估这些新增候选。APRIOR 随后利用实测加合物模式重排候选，而单独的模拟实验考察了何时应该保护首位。
lessons.takeaway: 先区分真实结构缺席和真实结构排得太低：前者需要补充候选，后者才适合重排。让辅助证据能否改动首位成为一项单独验证的决策。

steps.title: 用正负离子模式约束中性质量
steps.titleEN: Constrain Neutral Mass with Both Ion Modes
steps.body: 输入是同一分子的前体质量观测和已有候选列表。开启 `ENABLE_DUAL_MODE_MASS_SYNC = True` 后，方法联合使用 `[M+H]+` 与 `[M-H]-` 的前体质量来约束中性质量，容差为 `≤ 3.0 ppm`。根据得到的质量约束重排第 2–25 位，不改动第 1 位。
steps.bodyEN: The inputs are precursor mass observations for the same molecule and its existing candidate list. With `ENABLE_DUAL_MODE_MASS_SYNC = True`, the method combines `[M+H]+` and `[M-H]-` precursor observations to constrain the neutral mass using a tolerance of `≤ 3.0 ppm`. The resulting mass constraint reranks positions 2–25 without changing rank 1.
steps.why: 同一分子在两个离子模式下的观测可以共同收紧中性质量约束，让质量一致性参与排序，同时避免仅凭这项证据换掉首位。
steps.whyEN: Observations of the same molecule in both ion modes tighten the neutral-mass constraint, allowing mass consistency to inform the ranking without replacing the leader on that evidence alone.
steps.limit: 这一步需要同一分子同时具备两种指定加合物的观测；附件没有给出它的独立收益对照。
steps.limitEN: This step requires both specified adduct observations for the same molecule. The supplied excerpt does not show a standalone comparison measuring its benefit.

steps.title: 优先选择可变换的类似物，补充尾部候选
steps.titleEN: Prioritize Transformable Analogues to Expand the List Tail
steps.body: 在 Engine 1 的候选生成阶段，先根据类似物与查询谱的前体质量差，用 `casmi.derive.matching_transforms` 优先选择能匹配已知 `<= 2` 步化学变换的类似物。保留原有类似物特征列表以及 `gen_n_analog = 6` 和 `gen_max_total = 150`。只把来自原 P6 前 6 个母体之外的新生成结构插入 Engine 1 给出的 `3..25` 位，锁定第 1、2 位，保留已有候选的相对顺序，并用 RDKit `2026.03.3` 按 `(heavy_atom_composition, InChIKey-14)` 去重。启用 `ENABLE_P5_TAIL = True` 和 `RUN_FR325_AFTER_P5 = True` 时，P5 Tail 先于 `FR 3-25`，因此新增候选也会接受片段图评分。
steps.bodyEN: During Engine 1 candidate generation, use the precursor mass gap between each analogue and the query to prioritize analogues that match a known chemical transformation in `<= 2` steps via `casmi.derive.matching_transforms`. Keep the original analogue feature list and the settings `gen_n_analog = 6` and `gen_max_total = 150`. Insert only newly generated structures from parents outside the original P6 top 6 at their Engine 1 positions in `3..25`, locking ranks 1 and 2, preserving the relative order of existing candidates, and deduplicating by `(heavy_atom_composition, InChIKey-14)` with RDKit `2026.03.3`. With `ENABLE_P5_TAIL = True` and `RUN_FR325_AFTER_P5 = True`, P5 Tail precedes `FR 3-25`, so the fragment-graph scorer also evaluates the new candidates.
steps.why: 重排只能移动已经存在的候选；这一步先补充可能缺失的结构，再让后续评分器判断它们值不值得上移。
steps.whyEN: Reranking can only move candidates that are already present. This step adds potentially missing structures before the downstream scorer decides whether to move them up.
steps.limit: 候选能否补入取决于已知变换表和生成上限。原文引用了已有结果，但没有给出本笔记本中固定其他阶段、只切换 P5 Tail 的对照。
steps.limitEN: Candidate expansion depends on the known transformation table and the generation caps. The source cites a prior result but does not show a comparison in this notebook that toggles only P5 Tail while keeping the other stages fixed.

steps.title: 用实测加合物模式给候选重排
steps.titleEN: Rerank Candidates with Observed Adduct Patterns
steps.body: 从 `enveda-180` 取 `60,000` 个结构训练四个 LightGBM 分类器，分别对应 `[M+H]+`、`[M-H]-`、`[M+CH2O2-H]-` 和 `[M+Na]+`，后备模型为 `HistGradientBoostingClassifier`。输入包含 `1,057` 个 RDKit 特征：`1,024` 位半径为 2 的 Morgan 计数指纹、`22` 个酸碱 SMARTS 计数和 `11` 个理化描述符。对每个候选计算查询分子实测加合物模式的伯努利对数似然 `ll`，再按 `-1.5 * ln(rank) + 0.5 * ll` 重排第 2–25 位。设置 `APRIOR_KEEP1 = True`，保留第 1 位。
steps.bodyEN: Train four LightGBM classifiers on `60,000` `enveda-180` structures, one each for `[M+H]+`, `[M-H]-`, `[M+CH2O2-H]-`, and `[M+Na]+`, with `HistGradientBoostingClassifier` as the fallback. The inputs are `1,057` RDKit features: a `1,024`-bit radius-2 Morgan count fingerprint, `22` acid/base SMARTS counts, and `11` physicochemical descriptors. For each candidate, compute the Bernoulli log-likelihood `ll` of the query molecule's observed adduct pattern and rerank positions 2–25 by `-1.5 * ln(rank) + 0.5 * ll`. Set `APRIOR_KEEP1 = True` to preserve rank 1.
steps.why: 官能团会影响分子以何种加合物形式被观测到。把候选结构与实测加合物模式的相容性作为辅助证据，可以在保留原始名次信息的同时区分候选。
steps.whyEN: Functional groups affect which adducts are observed. Compatibility between a candidate structure and the observed adduct pattern provides secondary evidence while retaining information from the original ranking.
steps.limit: 方法依赖训练数据与目标数据的 timsTOF 采集条件可比；附件没有给出本笔记本中仅切换 APRIOR 的受控对照。
steps.limitEN: The method relies on comparable timsTOF acquisition conditions in training and target data. The supplied excerpt does not show a controlled comparison in this notebook that toggles APRIOR alone.

steps.title: 用主评分的分差决定是否锁定首位
steps.titleEN: Use the Primary Score Margin to Decide Whether to Lock Rank 1
steps.body: 这条规则以同一查询的主通道和辅助通道评分为输入。计算主通道前两名的 z 分数差，并与 `gate_margin` 比较。如果分差超过门槛，就锁定第 1 位，只允许辅助通道重排第 2–25 位。
steps.bodyEN: The rule takes primary and secondary channel scores for the same query. Compute the z-score gap between the top two candidates in the primary channel and compare it with `gate_margin`. If the gap exceeds the threshold, lock rank 1 and allow the secondary channel to reorder only ranks 2–25.
steps.why: 无加权的倒数排名融合不考虑评分差距，无条件混合则可能让较弱的辅助信号推翻主通道有把握的首位判断。
steps.whyEN: Unweighted reciprocal rank fusion ignores score margins, while unconditional blending can let weaker secondary evidence overturn a confident primary leader.
steps.limit: 原文只用合成查询验证了这一规则，没有在带标签的 timsTOF 验证集上验证；门槛仍需用真实折外谱图校准。
steps.limitEN: The source tests this rule on synthetic queries, not on a labeled timsTOF validation split. The threshold still needs calibration on real out-of-fold spectra.

llmReview.reason: 该笔记本提供了可复用的再排序方法：对双重加合物中性质量进行一致性同步、对库命中做分级并按阈值保守提升、用经验加合物先验（LightGBM 分类器+RDKit 特征）做对数似然重排、通过选择性门控保护 Rank-1，以及基于 RR 理论解释各步骤收益，方法链条可追踪、可检查。

lessons.titleEN: From Mass Spectra to Molecular Structures: Expand Candidates, Then Rerank with Mass and Adduct Evidence
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to infer the two-dimensional structures of small molecules in complex extracts from mass spectra and submit a ranked candidate list for each molecule. The true structure may be missing from the list altogether, or unreliable secondary evidence may push it down the ranking. The notebook first uses precursor masses from positive and negative ion modes to constrain existing candidates, then uses P5 Tail to add structures reachable by known chemical transformations so the fragment-graph scorer can evaluate them. APRIOR then reranks candidates using observed adduct patterns, while a separate simulation examines when to protect the top-ranked candidate.
lessons.takeawayEN: Distinguish a missing true structure from one that simply ranks too low: the former requires candidate expansion, while the latter is a reranking problem. Validate separately whether secondary evidence should be allowed to change rank 1.

exercise.zh: 建议实验：在带标签的 timsTOF 折外谱图上，固定每个查询的候选列表、主评分和辅助评分，对比仅主评分、无条件混合与使用 `0.20` 门槛的首位保护。记录 MRR@25，以及真实结构升到首位和跌出首位的次数。如果要调门槛，在一组折外预测上选择门槛，再在未参与选择的另一组上报告结果。
exercise.en: Suggested exercise: On labeled out-of-fold timsTOF spectra, hold each query's candidate list, primary scores, and secondary scores fixed. Compare primary scoring alone, unconditional blending, and rank-1 gating at `0.20`. Record MRR@25 and count how often the true structure moves into or out of rank 1. If you tune the threshold, choose it on one set of out-of-fold predictions and report the result on a separate set not used for selection.

findings.claim: 在合成压力测试中，`0.20` 门槛的首位保护得到 `0.6740`，高于无条件混合的 `0.6717` 和主通道的 `0.6594`；固定 `k = 3` 的倒数排名融合得到 `0.5608`。相比无条件混合，首位保护把有害的首位翻转从 `219` 次减到 `75` 次，净有益翻转从 `+29` 增到 `+51`。
findings.claimEN: In the synthetic stress test, rank-1 gating at `0.20` scored `0.6740`, above unconditional blending at `0.6717` and the primary channel at `0.6594`; reciprocal rank fusion with fixed `k = 3` scored `0.5608`. Compared with unconditional blending, gating reduced harmful rank-1 flips from `219` to `75` and increased net beneficial flips from `+29` to `+51`.
findings.setup: 在同一批 `4,000` 个异方差模拟查询上比较单用主通道、固定 `k = 3` 的倒数排名融合、无条件混合和首位保护。模拟设置为 `sec_signal = 0.55`、`sec_weight = 0.30`。
findings.setupEN: The same `4,000` simulated heteroskedastic queries were used to compare the primary channel alone, reciprocal rank fusion with fixed `k = 3`, unconditional blending, and rank-1 gating. The simulation used `sec_signal = 0.55` and `sec_weight = 0.30`.
findings.caveat: 这是合成压力测试，不是带标签的 timsTOF 验证；原文没有报告随机种子或标准误。
findings.caveatEN: This was a synthetic stress test, not a labeled timsTOF validation. The source does not report a random seed or standard error.

lessons.author: Arsen Zakaryan
lessons.title: 从文本识别生成模型：在阅读器集成上叠加词元对齐似然
lessons.summary: 任务是根据一段生成文本，在 18 个语言模型中识别其来源，评价指标为平衡准确率。难点之一是区分 glm-5.3 和 glm-5.3-flash，而对所有文本运行似然评分又受到时间预算限制。笔记本保留原有阅读器集成，只将旧的带前缀似然头替换为基于 115 个特征的逻辑回归与 LightGBM 混合头。作者在提示词互斥的五折单阅读器代理实验中观察到提升，但该实验没有验证完整集成。
lessons.takeaway: 将阅读器集成与似然头分开，便于在提示词互斥的折上比较头部替换；单阅读器代理结果不能当作完整集成的收益。

steps.title: 保留阅读器集成作为第一阶段
steps.titleEN: Keep the Reader Ensemble as the First Stage
steps.body: 将数据路径、序列化的阅读器配置和预拟合核心传给 `infer.py`。将 `tfidf_w`、`distort_w` 和 `svc_w` 都设为 `0`，将 `adapt_w` 和 `adapt_thr` 分别设为 `1.0` 和 `0.15`。将 `sinkhorn` 和 `sinkhorn_target_mix` 分别设为 `0.30` 和 `0.35`。原生专家使用 `native_share=0.40` 和 `native_cent=1`，分组相似度使用 `group_sim=0.70`，GSQ 专家的份额为 `0.03`。
steps.bodyEN: Pass the data path, serialized reader configuration, and prefit core to `infer.py`. Set `tfidf_w`, `distort_w`, and `svc_w` to `0`, and set `adapt_w` and `adapt_thr` to `1.0` and `0.15`, respectively. Set `sinkhorn` and `sinkhorn_target_mix` to `0.30` and `0.35`, respectively. The native expert uses `native_share=0.40` and `native_cent=1`, grouping uses `group_sim=0.70`, and the GSQ expert has a share of `0.03`.
steps.why: 保留已有的阅读器配置，让候选方案的主要改动集中在后续似然头。
steps.whyEN: Keeping the existing reader configuration isolates the candidate's main change to the downstream likelihood head.
steps.limit: 这些是运行配置，不是逐项消融结果；原文没有验证各权重的独立收益。
steps.limitEN: These are run settings, not component ablations; the source does not verify the individual benefit of each weight.

steps.title: 标准化词元证据并构造两套标签
steps.titleEN: Standardize Token Evidence and Build Two Label Sets
steps.body: 以从经核验的原始词元证据重建的特征矩阵 `X`、训练标签 `y` 和有序类别列表 `labels` 为输入。在传入的 `X` 上拟合 `StandardScaler`，再将其转换为 `xs`。保留原始多类目标，同时构造三分类目标：`glm-5.3` 映射为 `1`，`glm-5.3-flash` 映射为 `2`，其余映射为 `0`。导出记录保存类别顺序及标准化均值和尺度，不包含原始样本行。
steps.bodyEN: Start with feature matrix `X` reconstructed from verified original token evidence, training labels `y`, and ordered class list `labels`. Fit `StandardScaler` on the supplied `X` and transform it into `xs`. Keep the original multiclass target and build a three-class target: map `glm-5.3` to `1`, `glm-5.3-flash` to `2`, and all others to `0`. The export records class order and scaling means and scales without including raw rows.
steps.why: 代码同时保留完整归因目标，并为两个重点 GLM 类别构造单独的判别目标；保存类别顺序有助于推理时对齐输出。
steps.whyEN: The code retains the full attribution target while creating a separate target for the two GLM classes of interest; saving class order helps align outputs at inference.
steps.limit: 验证时应在各折的训练部分拟合标准化器；这个代码块没有列出全部词元特征，也没有单独验证标准化或三分类目标的收益。
steps.limitEN: During validation, fit the scaler on each fold's training partition. This block neither lists all token features nor separately validates the benefits of scaling or the three-class target.

steps.title: 为两个目标拟合逻辑回归和 LightGBM
steps.titleEN: Fit Logistic Regression and LightGBM for Both Targets
steps.body: 以标准化后的 `xs` 和两套目标为输入，分别训练 `h18` 和 `h3`。逻辑回归的 `C` 分别为 `.025` 和 `.03`，两者均设 `max_iter=1000`。LightGBM 使用多分类目标，两个头的 `n_estimators` 分别为 `220` 和 `240`，`min_child_samples` 分别为 `25` 和 `20`；每个头均使用种子 `[42,1042,2042]`。两头共享 `learning_rate=.03`、`num_leaves=15`、`subsample=.8`、`colsample_bytree=.7`、`reg_alpha=1.` 和 `reg_lambda=5.`。导出时保存类别顺序、逻辑回归系数和截距，以及序列化后的 LightGBM 模型。
steps.bodyEN: Use standardized `xs` and the two targets to train `h18` and `h3` separately. Logistic regression uses `C=.025` and `C=.03`, respectively, with `max_iter=1000` for both. LightGBM uses a multiclass objective: the heads use `n_estimators` of `220` and `240` and `min_child_samples` of `25` and `20`, respectively, with seeds `[42,1042,2042]` for each head. Both heads share `learning_rate=.03`, `num_leaves=15`, `subsample=.8`, `colsample_bytree=.7`, `reg_alpha=1.`, and `reg_lambda=5.`. Export class order, logistic regression coefficients and intercepts, and the serialized LightGBM models.
steps.why: 作者用逻辑回归和树模型共同构建似然头，并导出拟合结果供推理加载。
steps.whyEN: The author builds the likelihood head from logistic regression and tree models, then exports the fitted results for inference.
steps.limit: 原文没有报告仅使用逻辑回归、仅使用 LightGBM 或改变树模型种子数量的独立对照。
steps.limitEN: The source reports no separate comparison for logistic regression alone, LightGBM alone, or a different number of tree-model seeds.

steps.title: 按 GLM 概率排序，只重评分预算允许的文本
steps.titleEN: Rank by GLM Probability and Rescore Only What the Budget Allows
steps.body: V1 阶段以阅读器集成已写出的提交文件和 `final-logits.npz` 为输入。根据 `--select-classes` 指定的两个 GLM 类别的概率质量对文本排序，优先评分排名靠前的文本。覆盖数既受剩余运行时间限制，也不能超过 `--max-cover` 规定的比例。如果能评分的文本少于 `--min-texts`，则保留阅读器集成原先的提交。
steps.bodyEN: The V1 stage starts from the reader ensemble's submission file and `final-logits.npz`. Rank passages by the probability mass assigned to the two GLM classes specified by `--select-classes`, and score the highest-ranked passages first. Coverage is limited both by the remaining runtime and by the fraction specified in `--max-cover`. If fewer than `--min-texts` passages can be scored, keep the reader ensemble's original submission.
steps.why: V1 文档指出，全量评分无法在阅读器阶段之后的剩余时间内完成，而似然模块的收益主要来自区分两个 GLM 类别。
steps.whyEN: The V1 documentation says full scoring would not fit in the runtime remaining after the reader stage, and that the likelihood member's gains came mainly from distinguishing the two GLM classes.
steps.limit: 这段文档没有给出本候选运行的 `--max-cover` 或 `--min-texts` 实际取值；V1 的覆盖率对照也不能直接当作新头的结果。
steps.limitEN: This excerpt does not give the candidate run's actual `--max-cover` or `--min-texts` values, and the V1 coverage comparison should not be treated as a result for the new head.

llmReview.reason: 来源包含可复用的建模与验证方法：块27-29展示了特征标准化、LR与LightGBM混合头、固定超参数及可移植数值导出；块30-32说明了按类别概率排序的部分覆盖与时间预算推理流程；且进行了按prompt分组的验证审计。具备可追溯的建模与推断决策。

lessons.titleEN: Identifying the Generating Model: Adding Token-Aligned Likelihood to a Reader Ensemble
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to identify which of 18 language models generated a passage, using balanced accuracy as the evaluation metric. One challenge is distinguishing glm-5.3 from glm-5.3-flash, while scoring every passage for likelihood is constrained by the runtime budget. The notebook keeps the existing reader ensemble and replaces only the old prefixed likelihood head with a 115-feature logistic regression and LightGBM hybrid. The author observed an improvement in a five-fold, prompt-disjoint single-reader proxy experiment, but that experiment did not validate the full ensemble.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keeping the reader ensemble separate from the likelihood head makes it easier to compare head replacements on prompt-disjoint folds; a single-reader proxy result does not establish a full-ensemble gain.

exercise.zh: 建议用同一组提示词互斥的验证折和同一套单阅读器预测，分别接入旧似然头和 PB115 混合头。固定评分文本的选择规则和覆盖率，且只用每折的训练部分拟合标准化器和头部模型。记录逐折平衡准确率，以及被改对和被改错的样本数，检查平均提升是否掩盖了个别折的退步。
exercise.en: As a learning experiment, reuse the same prompt-disjoint folds and single-reader predictions with the old likelihood head and the PB115 hybrid head. Fix the passage-selection rule and coverage, and fit the scaler and heads using only each fold's training partition. Record per-fold balanced accuracy and counts of corrected and newly incorrect predictions to see whether an average improvement masks a regression in any fold.

findings.claim: 稀疏代理设置下，平衡准确率由 `.697947` 升至 `.702764`，有 25 条预测被改对、12 条被改错。
findings.claimEN: In the sparse proxy setting, balanced accuracy rose from `.697947` to `.702764`, with 25 predictions corrected and 12 made incorrect.
findings.setup: 在同一个提示词互斥的五折单阅读器代理设置下，对比替换似然头前后的结果。
findings.setupEN: Compare results before and after replacing the likelihood head in the same five-fold, prompt-disjoint single-reader proxy setting.
findings.caveat: 有一折的稀疏结果下降；描述性 95% 差值区间为 `[.000370,.009284]`。这是复用的探索性代理实验，不是完整集成验证。
findings.caveatEN: One sparse fold got worse; the descriptive 95% interval for the difference was `[.000370,.009284]`. This was a reused exploratory proxy, not full-ensemble validation.

findings.claim: V1 文档中的训练集折外对照显示，覆盖 15 %、20 % 和全量文本时，报告的增益分别为 `+0.030`、`+0.0315` 和 `+0.029`。在所报告的三个设置中，20 % 覆盖的增益最大。
findings.claimEN: In the V1 training-set out-of-fold comparison, the reported gains at 15 %, 20 %, and full coverage were `+0.030`, `+0.0315`, and `+0.029`, respectively. Of the three reported settings, 20 % coverage gave the largest gain.
findings.setup: 以 V1 的阅读器输出为起点，按两个 GLM 类别的概率质量排序，比较似然阶段在不同覆盖率下报告的折外增益。
findings.setupEN: Start from the V1 reader outputs, rank by probability mass on the two GLM classes, and compare the likelihood stage's reported out-of-fold gains at different coverage levels.
findings.caveat: 这段文档未给出折数、种子或不确定性估计；该对照属于 V1，不能验证替换后的似然头。
findings.caveatEN: The excerpt gives no fold count, seeds, or uncertainty estimates. The comparison belongs to V1 and does not validate the replacement likelihood head.
