lessons.title: 借相似股票预测波动率
lessons.author: nyanp
lessons.summary: 单只股票的一段历史太短。冠军为股票和时段寻找相似样本，再把邻居的统计特征提供给模型。
lessons.takeaway: 在时间切分固定的条件下，为一个基础特征加上邻居均值，比较各折误差。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 从训练订单簿读取 `time_id` 和买卖两侧的前两档报价，按股票和 `time_id` 取去重报价的最小相邻差 `tick`，用 `0.01 / tick` 估算原始价格。将价格整理成 `time_id × stock_id` 矩阵，按列均值填补缺失值，再做 min-max 缩放。用 t-SNE 将矩阵压到一维，设置 `n_components=1`、`perplexity=400`、`random_state=0`、`n_iter=2000`，再按一维坐标排序。若股票 `61`（AMZN）的首个价格高于末个价格，就反转顺序；作者还将恢复的训练走势与真实行情对照。最后按恢复的顺序做 4 折时间序列交叉验证，每折用 10% 的数据作验证。
steps.bodyEN: Read `time_id` and the first two ask and bid prices from the training order book; for each stock and `time_id`, take the smallest gap between consecutive distinct prices as `tick` and estimate the original price with `0.01 / tick`. Pivot the prices into a `time_id × stock_id` matrix, fill missing values with column means, and apply min-max scaling. Use t-SNE with `n_components=1`, `perplexity=400`, `random_state=0`, and `n_iter=2000`, then sort by the resulting one-dimensional coordinate. Reverse the order if the first price for stock `61` (AMZN) exceeds the last; the author also checked the reconstructed training price trends against actual market data. Use the recovered order for 4-fold time-series cross-validation, with 10% of the data used for validation in each fold.
steps.why: 恢复先后顺序后，验证集可以按时间构造；同一顺序也能用于检查特征分布是否随时间变化。
steps.whyEN: Recovering the chronology makes it possible to build validation sets in time order and to check whether feature distributions change over time.
steps.limit: 测试集的排序不保证正确，因此作者没有把恢复的测试顺序直接用于特征或模型。复现时须区分 `np.argsort` 返回的行位置与 `time_id` 索引标签，并在重排后保留 `time_id`。原文对验证一致性的评价是定性的，没有报告对照数值。
steps.limitEN: The recovered test order was not guaranteed to be correct, so the author did not feed it directly into features or models. When reproducing the code, distinguish the row positions returned by `np.argsort` from the `time_id` index labels and preserve `time_id` after reordering. The reported agreement was qualitative, with no numerical comparison against another validation design.
steps.titleEN: Validation Design

steps.title: 特征工程
steps.body: 以各股票在各 `time_id` 的观测特征为输入，其中过去 10 分钟的已实现波动率是预测下一段 10 分钟波动率的基础特征。价格近邻示例将 `price` 转为 `time_id × stock_id` 矩阵，按列均值填补并做 min-max 缩放，再用 `NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=n_max, p=1)` 查找相似时段，其中 `n_max = 40`。对 `book.log_return1.realized_volatility` 等特征做近邻聚合，使用 `N=2,3,5,10,20,40`，示例中的均值切片为 `[1:n]`，聚合结果按 `stock_id` 和 `time_id` 左连接回原表。相似股票之间也做聚合，两种近邻还能组合，例如对 5 个最接近的时段中 20 只波动率相似的股票计算平均 tau。
steps.bodyEN: Start with observed features for each stock and `time_id`, using realized volatility from the previous 10 minutes as a baseline feature for predicting volatility over the next 10 minutes. In the price-based example, pivot `price` into a `time_id × stock_id` matrix, fill missing values with column means, apply min-max scaling, and find similar time windows with `NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=n_max, p=1)`, where `n_max = 40`. Aggregate features such as `book.log_return1.realized_volatility` at `N=2,3,5,10,20,40`; the example averages over the slice `[1:n]` and left-joins the results on `stock_id` and `time_id`. Aggregation also runs across similar stocks, and the two neighborhood types can be combined, for example by averaging tau for 20 stocks with similar volatility across the 5 closest time windows.
steps.why: 即使无法可靠地认出下一个 `time_id`，也可以借用市场价格、波动率或成交量相近的时段，以及相似股票的观测值，为目标股票补充信息。
steps.whyEN: Even when the next `time_id` cannot be identified reliably, observations from similar stocks or from periods with similar prices, volatility, or trading volume can add context for the target stock.
steps.limit: 示例中 `kneighbors` 默认返回距离和索引，取特征时需要的是索引；若首项是样本自身，`[1:n]` 实际只聚合 `n-1` 项。竞赛做法不保证近邻都来自过去，迁移到实时预测时只能使用预测时已知的数据。原文报告了近邻特征的整体分数变化，但没有分别验证距离度量或邻域大小的收益。
steps.limitEN: By default, `kneighbors` returns both distances and indices; feature lookup needs the indices. If the first result is the query itself, `[1:n]` aggregates only `n-1` entries. The competition approach does not guarantee that neighbors come from the past, so live predictions must use only data available at prediction time. The write-up reports an overall score change for neighbor features, but does not isolate the gains from individual distance metrics or neighborhood sizes.
steps.titleEN: Feature Engineering

steps.title: 迁移与复现
steps.body: 以恢复了 `time_id` 顺序的数据和已生成的特征为输入，先用对抗验证检查哪些特征随时间变化。`trade.order_count` 与 `book.total_volume` 的聚合特征变化明显，因此用同一 `time_id` 内的排名替代这些特征的原值。再对偏度较大的特征应用 `np.log1p`。
steps.bodyEN: Start with the recovered `time_id` order and the engineered features, then use adversarial validation to identify features that change over time. Aggregates derived from `trade.order_count` and `book.total_volume` showed marked changes, so replace their raw values with ranks within the same `time_id`. Apply `np.log1p` to highly skewed features.
steps.why: 用同一时段内的相对排名降低模型对会随时间漂移的绝对数值的依赖；对偏态特征做对数变换，则是为了减轻第二阶段可能出现的大异常值对预测的影响。
steps.whyEN: Within-window ranks reduce reliance on absolute values that drift over time, while the log transform is intended to limit the effect of large outliers that might appear in the second stage.
steps.limit: 原文未说明并列排名的处理方式，也未给出筛选高偏度特征的阈值。作者只定性描述了很小的分数改善；这些处理能否降低第二阶段的表现波动，没有得到量化验证。
steps.limitEN: The write-up does not specify how rank ties were handled or what threshold defined high skew. The author describes only a small score improvement qualitatively; whether the transformations made second-stage performance more stable was not quantified.
steps.titleEN: Feature Processing for Transfer and Reproduction

lessons.titleEN: Borrow information from similar stocks to predict volatility
lessons.summaryEN: A short history for one stock contains little context. The winners found similar stocks and time windows and provided aggregated statistics from those neighbors to the model.
lessons.takeawayEN: On a fixed time split, add a neighbor mean for one baseline feature and compare error fold by fold.

exercise.zh: 从一个时间窗出发，列出选中的近邻、距离和各自的波动统计量。检查近邻是否都在切点之前可用，再比较不加近邻、简单平均和按距离加权三组误差。这样能分清改进来自额外信息还是提前使用了未来数据。
exercise.en: For one time window, list the chosen neighbors, distances and volatility statistics. Verify availability at the cutoff, then compare no neighbors, an unweighted mean and a distance-weighted mean. This separates useful context from accidental access to future data.

findings.claim: 加入近邻聚合特征后，报告的 RMSPE 从 0.21 降至 0.19。
findings.claimEN: The reported RMSPE fell from 0.21 to 0.19 after nearest-neighbor aggregation features were added.
findings.setup: 比较加入近邻聚合特征前后的竞赛分数；原文未说明这两次评分之间有哪些其他条件保持不变。
findings.setupEN: The comparison is between competition scores before and after adding nearest-neighbor aggregation features. The write-up does not specify which other conditions were held fixed.
findings.caveat: 原文未说明这组分数对应的评估划分、随机种子或误差范围。
findings.caveatEN: The evaluation split, random seeds, and uncertainty for these scores were not reported.

lessons.title: 先清理重复录音，再比较鸟声模型
lessons.summary: 作者检查训练录音是否重复，并从历届数据中筛选当年的目标鸟种。模型对照建立在经过清理的数据上。
lessons.takeaway: 先统计各鸟种的样本数，并检查重复录音是否落入不同折。
lessons.author: Volodymyr

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 作者结合时长、上传者与主要鸟种标签筛查重复录音，并手动移除部分重复项。
steps.bodyEN: Duration, uploader and primary species labels were used to screen for duplicates. The author removed a subset manually.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者用五折分层交叉验证评估模型，并围绕比赛采用的 cmAP 指标比较实验。
steps.bodyEN: Models were evaluated with five-fold stratified cross-validation and compared against the competition’s cmAP metric.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 把注意力声音事件检测的预测与各时刻的最大预测组合。原文将该调整的增益描述为较小。
steps.bodyEN: Attention-based sound-event predictions were combined with the maximum prediction over time. The author describes the gain from this adjustment as small.

lessons.titleEN: Clean duplicate recordings before comparing bird-call models
lessons.summaryEN: The author looked for repeated training audio and selected recordings of the target species from earlier editions. Models were then compared on the cleaned collection.
lessons.takeawayEN: Count examples by species and check whether duplicate recordings span validation folds.

exercise.zh: 挑出时长和鸟种相同的两份录音，听取片段确认是否真重复。以录音为单位固定折号，保存清理前后的每类验证分数。再打开推理融合，观察分数变化是否仍出现在同一批鸟种上。
exercise.en: Listen to two clips with the same duration and species before calling them duplicates. Assign folds at recording level and save per-species scores before and after cleaning. Then enable inference blending and inspect whether the same species benefit.

lessons.title: 从无标签声景里学鸟鸣
lessons.author: Team Kefir
lessons.summary: 比赛给了带鸟种标签的短录音，也给了没有标签的野外声景。冠军把两者放进同一套训练流程，让模型接触接近测试环境的背景声。
lessons.takeaway: 先固定一个验证折，比较只用标注录音和加入声景伪标签后的变化。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 不同折的信号强度分布不同。团队比较标准差、能量等统计量，检查为什么某一折表现特别好。
steps.bodyEN: Signal strengths varied across folds. The team examined standard deviation and energy to explain why one fold was unusually easy.

steps.title: 输入与训练
steps.body: 将 10 秒音频转成 128 个 Mel 频带的频谱图，配合预训练的 EfficientNet-B0 等卷积网络识别鸟种。
steps.bodyEN: Ten seconds of audio were converted into a 128-band Mel spectrogram. Pretrained convolutional models including EfficientNet-B0 then recognized species.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 作者提供了多种融合及耗时对照。先跑公开推理 Notebook 的单模型，再复现均值融合，分别记录耗时和榜分。
steps.bodyEN: The writeup compares ensembles and inference time. Start with one public inference model, then reproduce mean blending while recording runtime and score separately.

lessons.titleEN: Learn bird calls from unlabeled soundscapes
lessons.summaryEN: The competition provides labeled short recordings and unlabeled field soundscapes. The winners trained with both so the model encountered background audio closer to the test environment.
lessons.takeawayEN: Fix one fold. Compare labeled recordings alone with training that also uses pseudo-labeled soundscapes.

exercise.zh: 把一段声景的时间轴与模型输出对齐，选一个高置信鸟鸣段和一个背景噪声段听一遍。伪标签来自模型本身，可能把噪声也当成鸟。固定训练轮数和验证录音，只改变是否加入伪标签；同时检查安静段误报与各物种 AUC。
exercise.en: Align a soundscape with the model’s time-indexed predictions. Listen to one confident call and one background segment. Pseudo-labels come from a model that can mistake noise for a bird. Hold training epochs and validation recordings fixed, toggle pseudo-labels, and track quiet-segment false positives alongside per-species AUC.

lessons.title: 3rd Place Solution

lessons.author: Soheil Ayati
lessons.title: 第二名方案—基于时序三维检测与图结构跟踪的细胞定位与追踪
lessons.summary: 本方案针对在三维显微镜时序图像中定位和跟踪细胞的任务。关键难点在于细胞信号微弱且稀疏，注释不完整，以及跨帧时序信息的有效利用。作者提出结合多帧时序上下文的3D U-Net检测器，输出细胞中心、位置偏移和运动估计，并基于图结构进行候选细胞选择、时序链接和分裂判定。同时，采用合成弱信号细胞增强训练，保留弱探测候选直到通过轨迹连贯性判断其有效性。在后处理阶段利用未用候选恢复遗漏轨迹，且无需重新运行检测器，有效提升检测与跟踪性能。实验表明该管线在私有排行榜取得0.970分，具备稳定的跨嵌合体适应能力。
lessons.takeaway: 关键在于结合时序上下文的稳定三维检测，同时设计图结构追踪以充分利用运动与链接信息。训练中加入合成弱细胞以增强模型对低信号单元的识别能力。重要创新是推迟丢弃弱探测结果，通过轨迹连贯性判断其有效性并进行恢复，无需重新检测器，提升检测召回和整体分数。实验证明，仅在特定采集条件下使用此恢复策略效果最佳，且扩展检测或修复操作需谨慎以免引入误差。

steps.title: 输入与预处理
steps.titleEN: Input and Preprocessing
steps.body: 输入为64×256×256三维显微镜图像序列。首先对每帧图像进行强度归一化，并在空间维度上进行1×4×4的块平均下采样，令输入形状变为64×64×64，满足体素的各向同性（voxel spacing均匀）。利用原始高分辨率图像保留后续验证与精修所需信息。
steps.bodyEN: The input consists of 64×256×256 3D microscopy volume sequences. Each frame undergoes intensity normalization and then downsampling via 1×4×4 voxel block averaging in Z×Y×X order, resulting in isotropic voxel size and an input shape of 64×64×64. Original high-resolution images are retained for later verification and refinement.

steps.title: 基于多帧时序上下文的三维检测
steps.titleEN: 3D Detection with Multi-Frame Temporal Context
steps.body: 采用残差3D U-Net网络，以相邻三帧（t−1, t, t+1）作为输入通道，形状为3×64×64×64。模型预测细胞中心热图、亚体素级位置偏移、上一帧运动向量及其不确定度，以及图像描述符用于时间链接。辅助检测器使用更多帧的时序信息或其他模型赋能探测多样性和鲁棒性。
steps.bodyEN: A residual 3D U-Net takes three consecutive frames (t−1, t, t+1) as input channels (shape 3×64×64×64). The model outputs cell center heatmaps, sub-voxel spatial offsets, backward motion vectors with uncertainties, and image descriptors to assist temporal linking. Auxiliary detectors employ more frames or alternative models to enhance detection diversity and robustness.

steps.title: 合成弱细胞增强及监督设计
steps.titleEN: Synthetic Faint Cell Augmentation and Supervision Design
steps.body: 针对稀疏标注及弱信号细胞，采用合成数据增强，将真实标注的细胞轨迹提取后进行信号衰减与模糊处理，插入训练影像的不同区域以形成弱细胞样本，且保持数据分组一致。损失函数设计排除未知区域，分开归一化细胞和背景损失，降低伪负样本影响，提升弱细胞识别能力。
steps.bodyEN: To handle sparse annotations and faint cells, synthetic augmentation extracts short isolated cell tracks, dims and blurs them along depth, and blends them into other regions within the same movie, creating weak cell samples while preserving training splits. Loss functions exclude unknown regions and normalize cell and background losses separately to reduce false negatives and enhance faint cell detection.
steps.reference: ### 3.1. Sparse supervision and synthetic faint cells

steps.title: 图结构跟踪及细胞分裂识别
steps.titleEN: Graph-Based Tracking and Division Scoring
steps.body: 跟踪模块先通过LightGBM模型估计每帧的细胞数，并根据检测置信度及空间约束选择候选细胞，防止重复。利用预测的运动向量提出后继候选，并通过学习链接评分类别特征（距离、运动一致性等）解析前后帧关联。分裂判别器基于几何、外观和时序上下文评估父细胞与两个子细胞，辅助构建合理细胞分裂轨迹。辅助手段包括不同模型生成的候选补充和链接多模型共识，进一步修复图结构。
steps.bodyEN: The tracking module uses LightGBM to estimate the number of cells per frame and selects candidates balancing detection confidence and spatial distinctness, suppressing duplicates. Predicted backward motion guides candidate predecessor selection, with learned scorers evaluating link features such as distance and motion consistency to resolve temporal associations. A division scorer evaluates candidate parent-daughter triplets based on geometry, appearance, and temporal context. Auxiliary models provide missing path candidates and consensus on links and divisions to refine the graph.
steps.reference: ## 4. From candidates to tracks and divisions

steps.title: 基于未用检测的细胞轨迹恢复与边界清理
steps.titleEN: Recovery of Faint Tracks from Unused Detections and Border Cleanup
steps.body: 检测器输出细胞候选多于跟踪保留。V533方案针对采集组acq_01限制下游，复查未用但排位较高且距离现有轨迹较远超过4.5μm的候选，构建至少连续九帧的移动路径（位置变动≤5μm），并基于原始影像中心与背景对比度阈值（≥0.1）确认有效。恢复路径要求与现有轨迹近邻（≤8μm），可附着至轨迹端点扩展或作为新轨迹独立存在。该过程无需重新运行检测器，无新增标注，无新训练。另有对x/y边界1.5像素内预测及其链路的清理以减少边界伪影。
steps.bodyEN: The detector outputs more candidates than the tracker retains. V533 revisits unused, high-ranked candidates more than 4.5 μm from existing predictions (restricted to acquisition group acq_01), links them into persistent paths spanning nine or more consecutive frames with position shifts ≤5 μm per frame, and verifies path validity by median center-to-background contrast ≥0.1 on original images. Candidate paths must be within 8 μm proximity of existing tracks to propose attachments or remain separate if unattached. This recovery does not rerun the detector, access annotations, or retrain models. Additionally, predictions within 1.5 pixels near the x/y frame boundary are removed to reduce boundary artifacts.
steps.reference: ## 5. Recovering faint tracks without another detector pass

llmReview.reason: 该方案包含可复用的具体方法：3D U-Net 结合时序上下文检测、合成暗淡细胞增广、LightGBM 候选选择与图追踪/分裂评分、基于未用候选的弱轨迹恢复及图像证据校验、按图像条件聚类的分组验证与消融。读者可追踪检测、追踪、恢复和验证等决策链，符合可解释步骤要求。

lessons.titleEN: 2nd Place Solution: Temporal 3D Detection and Graph-Based Cell Tracking
lessons.summaryEN: This solution addresses the task of locating and tracking cells in temporal 3D microscopy images. The main challenges include weak and sparse cell signals, incomplete annotations, and effective utilization of temporal information across frames. The author uses a multi-frame 3D U-Net detector to estimate cell centers, position offsets, and motion, followed by graph-based candidate selection, temporal linking, and division scoring. Synthetic faint cells are augmented during training. Weak detection evidence is preserved until validated through trajectory coherence. A late recovery step revisits unused candidates without rerunning detection to restore missing tracks. Experiments show the pipeline achieves 0.970 on the private leaderboard with robustness across embryo variations.
lessons.takeawayEN: The key lies in robust temporal 3D detection combined with graph-based tracking that leverages motion and linking cues. Augmenting training with synthetic faint cells improves detection of low-signal units. A critical innovation is delaying discarding weak detections and validating them through trajectory coherence to recover missed tracks without rerunning the detector, improving recall and overall score. This recovery strategy works best under specific acquisition conditions. Careful balance is necessary when extending detection or repair steps to avoid introducing errors.

exercise.zh:
1. 尝试在单一3D U-Net模型中引入相邻多帧输出来提升检测准确性；
2. 实施合成数据增强，将真实细胞轨迹提取后进行衰减与模糊处理，插入训练样本，以提升模型对弱信号细胞的识别能力；
3. 基于检测器输出的候选点构建时序图，设计评分函数进行轨迹链接和细胞分裂识别；
4. 实现一个后处理步骤，利用未被跟踪选中但置信较高的检测点，根据时间和空间连贯性恢复遗漏的轨迹。

lessons.author: Sergio Alvarez
lessons.title: 分开检查目标检测、跨帧关联和轨迹解码
lessons.summary: 冠军沿用先检测后跟踪的思路，但让关联模型同时看到目标附近的图像变化。判断哪里发生了身份交换时，能够回到检测、短时运动线索和相邻帧链接三个阶段逐项排查。
lessons.takeaway: 固定一小段已标注的图像序列，分别统计漏检和错误关联，再决定先改哪一段。

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.titleEN: Detect candidate centers
steps.body: 作者用 U-Net 预测前景概率和朝向中心的位移场，从三维图像得到候选目标。
steps.bodyEN: A U-Net predicts foreground probability and a field pointing toward centers to generate candidate detections from each volume.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.titleEN: Read three adjacent frames
steps.body: 局部模型读取同一候选附近连续三帧的裁剪图像，估计状态以及前后位置，为跨帧关联提供外观线索。
steps.bodyEN: A local model takes crops from three neighboring frames and estimates state and positions across time, supplying visual cues for association.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.titleEN: Associate neighboring frames
steps.body: 学习式关联器在相邻两帧间判断哪些候选应当连接，也处理一对多的分支，之后将这些决策组织成轨迹。
steps.bodyEN: A learned linker selects correspondences between adjacent frames, including branching associations. These decisions are then decoded into tracks.

lessons.titleEN: Separate detection, frame linking and track decoding
lessons.summaryEN: The winner used tracking by detection and added learned visual cues around each candidate. An identity switch can be traced back through detection, short-term appearance and motion cues, and links between consecutive frames.
lessons.takeawayEN: Hold out a short annotated sequence and separate missed detections from incorrect links before choosing a stage to change.

exercise.zh: 在连续三帧上给同一目标画出编号，先用真实位置检查匹配，再换回预测位置。如果关联错误随检测替换才出现，应先检查检测误差传播；如果真实位置上也错，则重点检查跨帧匹配。
exercise.en: Mark the same object across three frames. Test links using reference positions, then substitute predicted detections. Errors introduced only by this substitution point toward detection error propagation. Errors present in both runs point toward the linker.

lessons.author: Team Alicia
lessons.title: 第二名方案解析
lessons.summary: 本方案针对预测电动车购买倾向的二分类任务，面对庞大的数据规模和潜在的生成器数据特性，设计了严格的验证机制和多层堆叠模型。采用TabPFN-3.5模型在完整上下文中训练，结合基于生成器的无标签似然比特征（LLR）和多模型堆叠，最后通过精确计算的AUC直接优化目标融合多个模型预测结果。作者着重强调了验证优先、避免过拟合公共排行榜的策略，并利用生成模型的概率特性提取辅助特征，取得了私有排行榜第二名的成绩。
lessons.takeaway: 1. 严格的嵌套交叉验证和公私分数差异分析是防止过拟合公榜的关键。2. 利用生成数据的潜在采样机制构造无标签的LLR特征，有助于提升模型性能。3. TabPFN-3.5能通过完整上下文训练显著提高AUC，且模型性能与上下文大小呈线性提升关系。4. 直接以近似全局AUC为目标的线性组合优化，有效提升最终预测性能。

steps.title: 任务及数据概述
steps.titleEN: Task and Data Overview
steps.body: 任务是基于表格的13个特征（7数值，6类别），预测电动车购买倾向的二分类问题。训练集包含668,665行数据，测试集286,571行，且数据由合成生成器产生，存在内在的生成器特征，导致公私榜分数差异明显。数据中正例比例17.46%，无训练测试分布漂移，且竞赛提供了原始小规模真实数据集用于分析生成规则。
steps.bodyEN: The task is a tabular binary classification to predict electric vehicle purchase intent using 13 features (7 numeric, 6 categorical). The training set has 668,665 rows, test set 286,571 rows. The data is synthesized from a generator, leading to intrinsic generator features and notable public-private leaderboard score gaps. The positive rate is 17.46%, no train-test distribution shift, and original smaller real data (10k rows) is provided for inspecting the generating formula.

steps.title: 验证策略与数据分割
steps.titleEN: Validation Strategy and Data Splitting
steps.body: 采用5折嵌套交叉验证，严格定义"诚实"的验证规则，不直接利用公共排行榜作为选择标准。使用固定折拆分，并留出133,733行为封存持出集只在最终训练时纳入。预注册候选模型和结果，所有模型必须通过严格的增益门槛才能进入最终验证。通过对比公私分表现，发现公榜相关度不及嵌套交叉验证的分数，避免了过拟合公榜。
steps.bodyEN: Utilized 5-fold nested cross-validation with strict 'honest' validation policies, avoiding use of public leaderboard for model selection. Fixed folds used, with 133,733 rows sealed holdout set only used in final refit. Candidates and their results were pre-registered; models had to meet strict gain thresholds for advancement. Comparison shows private and nested validation scores highly correlated but public scores less so, preventing leaderboard overfitting.

steps.title: 基于生成器的无标签似然比特征构造
steps.titleEN: Generator Surrogate Label-Free LLR Feature Construction
steps.body: 假设训练数据来自语言模型微调生成的样本，作者使用distilgpt2微调仅使用原始10,000行训练样本（不含竞赛标签），通过计算“Will_Buy_EV是Yes”与“No”条件下样本的生成对数似然之差，生成标注无关的似然比特征（LLR）。LLR在单模型和堆叠中均显著提升性能，成为重要辅助特征。采用多种微调方案平均进一步增加效果，且作为输入特征融入带来的收益大于直接拼接作为普通特征。
steps.bodyEN: Assuming data comes from a fine-tuned LM generator, the authors fine-tuned distilgpt2 only on the original 10k rows without competition labels. They computed the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) of a row under conditions “Will_Buy_EV=Yes” vs “No” across 4 random column orderings. This label-free surrogate LLR feature significantly improved single and stacked models, serving as important auxiliary inputs. Averaging multiple fine-tuned variants further increased gain. Feeding LLR as input rather than raw column yielded better results.

steps.title: TabPFN-3.5大上下文训练及效益
steps.titleEN: TabPFN-3.5 Training with Full Context and Benefits
steps.body: 使用TabPFN-3.5模型，针对每折在剩余约428,000条完整上下文中训练，测试阶段使用全部668,665行数据。该方法在不做上下文子采样的情况下，随着上下文量翻倍AUC持续以约+18.6u的幅度线性提升，未见饱和值。基于此，该技术实现了高效且优异的单模型性能，并对最终堆叠贡献显著。上下文大小对性能贡献远大于模型推理相关超参数调整。
steps.bodyEN: The TabPFN-3.5 model was trained for each fold on the full remaining ~428k context rows, and during test on all 668,665 labeled rows. Without any context subsampling, AUC rose approximately +18.6 units per doubling of context size, showing no saturation. This led to highly effective single-model performance and significant boosting effect in stacking. Context size impact outweighed inference parameter tuning.

steps.title: 基于近似全对偶AUC的层级融合优化
steps.titleEN: Level-3 Blend Optimization via Smoothed Pairwise AUC
steps.body: 最终层融合采用非负权重、权重和为1的线性组合，直接最小化由logit排名分组成的平滑近似全对偶AUC损失。正负样本对数量巨大（约2.6e10），计算用FFT和插值直方图实现高效准确求解。该方法较基于对数损失的融合提升+1.62u，并得到严格嵌套验证通过，且提升主要源自减少AUC优化目标的偏差，说明直接优化对应指标比间接优化更有效。
steps.bodyEN: The level-3 ensemble used a non-negative linear weight combination summing to 1, minimizing a smoothed pairwise AUC loss defined on rank-logits. The extremely large number of positive-negative pairs (~2.6e10) is handled exactly via FFT convolution and linear interpolation histograms. This achieved +1.62u gain over the log-loss based stacking, passed strict nested cross-validation. Results show direct AUC objective optimization reduces metric bias better than indirect log-loss approaches.

llmReview.reason: 该方案给出了可复现的建模、验证与优化细节：预注册的嵌套交叉验证与门控协议、TabPFN全上下文使用及上下文规模规律、GReaT式LLR替代特征构造，以及用直方图+FFT精确计算成对AUC目标的第三层混合代码，均包含可检验的方法与代码，远超结果公告。

lessons.titleEN: 2nd Place Solution Analysis
lessons.summaryEN: This solution addresses the binary classification task of predicting electric vehicle purchase intent, handling large-scale data and features generated by a synthetic data generator. A strict validation regimen and multi-level model stacking are used. TabPFN-3.5 is trained with the full context, combined with generator-based label-free log-likelihood ratio (LLR) features, and multiple models are stacked and blended via an exact AUC-optimized objective. Emphasizing validation-first and avoiding public leaderboard overfitting, the method leverages generator probability approximations for auxiliary features, resulting in a second-place finish on the private leaderboard.
lessons.takeawayEN: 1. Strict nested cross-validation and careful analysis of public-private leaderboard score discrepancies are essential to avoid overfitting public leaderboard. 2. Leveraging generator-based label-free LLR features improves model performance. 3. Training TabPFN-3.5 with full context substantially boosts AUC, showing a log-linear relationship with context size. 4. Directly optimizing a smoothed global AUC objective for ensemble weights effectively enhances the final predictions.

exercise.zh: 尝试使用TabPFN模型，基于完整上下文数据进行训练，并观察不同上下文规模对AUC的影响。然后使用distilgpt2微调生成LLR特征，作为模型额外输入，比较有无LLR时模型性能的区别。最后，设计一个包含非负权重和权重和约束的线性融合，使用FFT高效计算平滑AUC损失进行权重优化，完成模型融合。
exercise.en: Try training TabPFN models using full context data and observe how different context sizes affect AUC. Then fine-tune distilgpt2 to generate LLR features as auxiliary inputs, comparing model performance with and without LLR. Finally, implement a linear blend with non-negative weights summing to one, optimizing weights using FFT-based efficient computation of smoothed AUC loss for ensemble combination.

lessons.title: 把六十个表格模型的预测合成一份购买排序
lessons.summary: 冠军在多轮实验中保留可复用的代码与笔记，最终用逻辑回归融合 60 个模型的预测。这里最值得复现的是怎样比较新增模型带来的排序变化，以及怎样区分本地、公开榜和最终榜。
lessons.takeaway: 先拿两组折外预测训练融合器，用独立留出样本检查比最佳单模多排对了哪些样本对。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.titleEN: AUC and pair ordering
steps.body: AUC 衡量真实购买者排在非购买者前面的概率。作者用本地验证与两种榜单分数记录实验进展。
steps.bodyEN: AUC measures the chance that a buyer ranks ahead of a non-buyer. The team recorded validation, public and private scores for successive stages.

steps.title: 复现与核查
steps.titleEN: Experiment handoffs
steps.body: 团队在不同阶段交接代码、计划和实验记录，使后续阶段有基线和以往结果可比。
steps.bodyEN: Code, plans and experiment notes were passed between stages, preserving baselines and previous results for comparison.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.titleEN: Logit stacking
steps.body: 最终 60 个模型包括 XGBoost、神经网络和线性模型。各模型预测先转为 logit，再由逻辑回归估计融合权重。
steps.bodyEN: The final pool included XGBoost, neural networks and linear models. Predictions from 60 models were converted to logits and combined with logistic regression.

lessons.titleEN: Combine sixty tabular models into one purchase ranking
lessons.summaryEN: The winners carried code and experiment notes across successive rounds of modeling. Their final stack used logistic regression on predictions from 60 models. The writeup reports local, public and private scores, allowing readers to compare progress across all three.
lessons.takeawayEN: Fit a two-model stack from out-of-fold predictions, then inspect the extra positive–negative pairs it orders correctly on a held-out set.

exercise.zh: 给每一版模型保存折号、折外概率和测试概率。先尝试等权平均，再把概率变成 logit 训练逻辑回归。用未参与调权的样本评价两种融合，检查提升是否主要来自某一类客户。
exercise.en: Save fold IDs, out-of-fold probabilities and test probabilities for each model. Start with an equal-weight blend, then train logistic regression on logits. Evaluate both on rows untouched by weight selection and check whether improvements concentrate in one customer group.

lessons.title: 让六个写作维度各自选模型
lessons.author: AutoX & Rohit & Yevhenii
lessons.summary: 冠军先训练多种文本编码器并保留折外预测，再为六个评分维度分别学习融合权重。
lessons.takeaway: 保留每个模型的折外预测，比较统一权重和每个目标单独调权的误差。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者报告融合后的本地验证与榜单变化方向接近；调权使用折外预测，能减轻在训练样本上选权重的偏差。
steps.bodyEN: The authors report that local and leaderboard changes tracked one another. Learning weights on out-of-fold predictions reduces the bias of selecting weights on fitted examples.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 团队改变文本池化、输入长度和编码器，利用伪标签增加训练样本。这些改变提供不同的模型误差。
steps.bodyEN: The team varied pooling, sequence length and encoder architecture and added pseudo-labeled essays. These choices created models with different error patterns.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 先按单个维度看误差，随后用 Optuna 为各维度调权。可从公开训练代码和最佳提交版本对照复现。
steps.bodyEN: They inspected errors by dimension and used Optuna to tune weights separately. Public training code and the best submission provide reproduction references.

lessons.titleEN: Learn separate ensemble weights for six writing scores
lessons.summaryEN: The winners trained several text encoders, retained out-of-fold predictions and learned a separate set of ensemble weights for each of the six writing dimensions.
lessons.takeawayEN: Save out-of-fold predictions for each encoder. Compare a shared weight vector with a separate vector per target.

exercise.zh: 做一张表，每行是一篇留出作文，每列是某个模型对某一维度的预测。先给所有模型相同权重，再只改变一个维度的权重。分别记录六列误差，检查某一项的收益是否被另一项的退步抵消。
exercise.en: Build a table with one held-out essay per row and a column for each model–target prediction. Start with equal weights and change the weights for one dimension only. Record all six errors to see whether a gain on one dimension hides a loss elsewhere.

lessons.originalTitle: [3rd place] All Medalists Who BC'd on Our Records MUST Vote!
lessons.author: DSM
lessons.title: 铜牌方案解析：BC 预训练、PPO 自对弈与推理时后处理
lessons.summary: 该方案针对一个双人农场模拟游戏，目标是最大化最终资金以获胜。难点在于奖励稀疏（仅最终胜负）、每步决策多（31个）、市场共享导致策略依赖对手。方法动机：先通过行为克隆（BC）从顶尖队伍回放中学习基础策略，再使用 PPO 自对弈强化，并在推理时加入基于规则的后处理以修复无效动作和利用市场机制。
lessons.takeaway: 在长时程、稀疏奖励的竞争环境中，结合模仿学习与自对弈强化学习，并在推理时谨慎加入仅修复确定无效动作的规则，能显著提升胜率。

steps.title: 数据收集与行为克隆预训练
steps.titleEN: Data Collection and Behavior Cloning Pretraining
steps.body: 作者从顶尖队伍的回放中提取状态-动作对，训练一个 Transformer 策略网络来模仿教师动作。输入包括棋盘、单位、商店等 token，输出每个单位的移动和市场订单。通过加权损失（如对购买土地动作加权）和教师嵌入，模型学会了基础策略，为后续 PPO 提供起点。
steps.bodyEN: Authors extracted state-action pairs from top teams' replays to train a Transformer policy network to imitate teacher moves. Input includes board, units, shops as tokens; output is unit moves and market orders. Using weighted loss (e.g., weight 20 for BUY_LAND) and teacher embeddings, the model learns a base policy, providing a starting point for PPO.

steps.title: PPO 自对弈训练
steps.titleEN: PPO Self-play Training
steps.body: 在 BC 预训练的基础上，使用 PPO 进行自对弈训练。奖励仅为最终胜负（±1），采用非对称批评家（antisymmetric critic）和逐决策裁剪（clip per decision）来稳定训练。通过异步演员-学习器架构和大规模并行，模型在数千代中进化，胜率显著提升。
steps.bodyEN: Building on BC pretraining, PPO is used for self-play training. Reward is only final win/loss (±1), with an antisymmetric critic and per-decision clipping to stabilize training. Using asynchronous actors-learners and large-scale parallelism, the model evolves over thousands of generations, significantly improving win rate.

steps.title: 推理时后处理
steps.titleEN: Inference-time Post-processing
steps.body: 在推理阶段，作者加入规则来修复确定无效的动作（如无效的 CARE、谷仓溢出销售等），并加入特定规则（如购买瓜种子）。这些规则不影响模型权重，仅对动作进行后处理，从而将胜率从 74.2% 提升至 87.8%。
steps.bodyEN: At inference, rules are added to fix certainly wasted moves (e.g., ineffective CARE, barn overflow selling) and specific rules (e.g., buying melon seeds). These rules do not affect model weights, only post-process actions, raising win rate from 74.2% to 87.8%.
steps.reference: 7.2 Fixing only moves that certainly have no effect

llmReview.reason: 该文详细披露了可复用的建模与优化方法：BC + 异步 PPO 训练流程、按决策裁剪的 PPO、反对称 critic、训练时干预将改写动作记为策略自身动作、以及基于官方规则的推理后处理与配对种子 A/B 评测。方法可逐步追溯，含具体公式、超参数与消融数据，非空泛结果宣告。

lessons.titleEN: Bronze Medal Solution Analysis: BC Pretraining, PPO Self-play, and Inference-time Post-processing
lessons.summaryEN: This solution targets a two-player farm simulation game, aiming to maximize final money to win. Challenges include sparse reward (only final win/loss), many decisions per step (31), and a shared market making strategies opponent-dependent. Motivation: first learn a base policy via behavior cloning (BC) from top teams' replays, then strengthen with PPO self-play, and add rule-based post-processing at inference to fix wasted moves and exploit market mechanisms.
lessons.takeawayEN: In long-horizon, sparse-reward competitive environments, combining imitation learning with self-play reinforcement learning, and carefully adding inference-time rules that only fix certainly wasted moves, can significantly improve win rate.

exercise.zh: 在类似的长时程游戏环境中，先使用专家回放训练一个模仿学习策略，然后实现 PPO 自对弈，并尝试在推理时加入一个仅修复确定无效动作的规则，测量其对胜率的影响。
exercise.en: In a similar long-horizon game environment, first train an imitation learning policy from expert replays, then implement PPO self-play, and try adding an inference-time rule that only fixes certainly wasted moves, measuring its impact on win rate.

lessons.author: MURAD
lessons.title: 2nd Place Solution
lessons.summary: 获奖队伍已公开赛后复盘，最终名次已与队伍记录核对。
lessons.takeaway: 先阅读作者的验证设计与模型选择，再对照最终成绩。

lessons.author: Team Kangaroo🦘
lessons.title: 把训练报告变成监督信号，在影像中定位异常
lessons.summary: 这是冠军队一位成员的分支。4,407 份训练检查中仅 58 份带完整的 12 项标签，训练端另有文字报告。作者利用这些资料补充软标签与区域框，测试时依靠影像预测。
lessons.takeaway: 在同一组留出检查上比较全图汇聚与区域内汇聚，并按异常类别记录误差。

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.titleEN: Training supervision
steps.body: 团队从训练报告与图像得到各项异常的概率、感兴趣区域与切片病灶框，把这些监督信号区分开来。
steps.bodyEN: The team derived finding probabilities, regions of interest and per-slice lesion boxes from the available training material and used them as distinct supervision signals.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.titleEN: Pooling inside a region
steps.body: ConvNeXt-T 编码每张切片。某项异常的区域框与特征格的重叠度决定初始权重，随后在框内学习注意力。
steps.bodyEN: ConvNeXt-T encodes slices. Overlap with a finding’s region box sets the initial pooling weights, then attention is learned within that box.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.titleEN: Held-out studies
steps.body: 作者按检查划分五折，单独保留 58 份金标准检查作为参照，并比较不同软标签上的折外 AUC。
steps.bodyEN: The author used five study-level folds, kept the 58 gold-labeled studies separate as a reference and compared out-of-fold AUC against different soft labels.

lessons.titleEN: Convert training reports into supervision for image classification
lessons.summaryEN: This is one branch of the winning team. Only 58 of 4,407 training studies had all 12 labels, while reports were available during training. The author used this extra information to derive soft labels and region boxes for an image-based inference pipeline.
lessons.takeawayEN: Compare global pooling with region-based pooling on the same held-out studies and report error by finding.

exercise.zh: 挑一项异常，在同一份检查上对比区域框轻微偏移前后的预测。对多个序列分别打分再取平均，可检查一个错误区域是否拖累整份检查。文字报告只在训练端可用，本地推理也要遵守相同限制。
exercise.en: For one finding, shift its region box slightly and compare predictions on the same study. Inspect series scores before averaging to see whether one poor region dominates the result. Exclude reports during local inference just as at test time.

lessons.originalTitle: 3rd Place Solution: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection 2026
lessons.author: DataTech Club
lessons.title: 从报告软标签到2.5D MRI阅读器：RSNA膝部异常检测第三名方案拆解
lessons.summary: 该任务要求基于膝部 MRI 图像预测 12 个异常标签，以 ROC AUC 评估，但 4407 个训练研究中仅有 58 个具有专家裁定标签，其余只有多语言报告。作者的做法是：用 GPT-6 Astra 结合 MRI 与报告为多模态软标签（N 版本），再对 PF OA、Lateral OA、Synovitis 做专科读者修正并用分位数映射保留排序（R 版本）；随后训练 2.5D 阅读器（相邻三层切片堆叠为三通道，BiT/ConvNeXt/DINOv3/CoAtNet 骨干，可选深度注意力与 OA 耦合头），并以固定分组预算的概率融合集成。难点在于图像级评价与报告监督之间的错位、标签噪声以及集成权重容易随实验数量失控。
lessons.takeaway: 监督信号的质量与构造方式可能比模型结构更关键：先用图像+报告生成连续软标签，再按发现分层修正标签并固定分组预算做概率融合；同时注意公开/私有榜三位小数下 0.959 并不能证明 Gold 重训或分组策略有优势。

steps.title: 用图像+报告构造12维连续软标签
steps.titleEN: Construct 12 continuous soft targets from images plus reports
steps.body: 输入是每个研究的 MRI 切片与多语言报告。操作：让 GPT-6 Astra 先看 MRI（PF 专科用同一平面/序列组最多 9 张 384px 采样切片的有序拼图），检查位置、严重度与范围，再与报告核对，输出 12 个连续目标；其他报告阅读器意见仅作佐证而非投票，接受的修改只改相关目标。学生模型在冻结快照上训练，看不到报告或阅读器解释。这样做的动机是报告可能漏报或描述低于竞赛阳性阈值的变化，纯文本标签会把图像级目标带偏。局限：这是模型辅助标注，可能引入系统性偏差，作者也未报告该步骤的独立消融。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are each study's MRI slices and multilingual report. GPT-6 Astra first examines the MRI (for the PF specialist, ordered sheets of up to nine sampled 384-px slices from one plane/sequence group), checks location, severity and extent, then reconciles with the report to assign 12 continuous targets. Other report-reader opinions are supporting evidence, not votes, and accepted revisions change only the relevant targets. Student models train on frozen snapshots without reports or reader explanations. The motivation is that reports can omit findings or describe changes below the competition's positive threshold, so purely text-derived labels would misdirect an image-level target. Limitation: this is model-assisted annotation that may carry systematic bias, and no isolated ablation of this step is reported.
steps.reference: 1.1 Read the images, not just the diagnostic terms

steps.title: 按发现修正标签并用分位数映射保留排序
steps.titleEN: Refine labels per finding and preserve ordering via quantile mapping
steps.body: 输入是 N 版本目标与专科读者的修正结果。操作：接受 Lateral OA 与 Synovitis 的专科排序后得到 R 版本；在每个被接受的修正子集内，用新排序选取旧目标的分位数，未修正条目保持不变。动机是新读者可能同时改变排序与概率尺度，分位数映射把两者分开，从而在保留新排序的同时限制尺度漂移。作者明确 R 是目标变换而非 ranking loss，且该映射只用于修正子集内部，不用于测试集预测。局限：它依赖读者对子集的排序质量，且 N 与 R 两版都进入模型池，混合效果未做单因素隔离。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are the N targets and specialist revisions. After accepting specialist rankings for Lateral OA and Synovitis, version R is produced: within each accepted revision subset, ranks select quantiles of the previous targets while unrevised entries stay fixed. The motivation is that a new reader can change both ordering and probability scale; quantile mapping separates these effects, preserving the new ordering while limiting scale changes. The authors state R is a target transformation, not a ranking loss, and the mapping applies only inside revision subsets, not to test-set predictions. Limitation: it depends on the quality of the specialist ordering, and since both N and R enter the pool, their mixing is not isolated as a single-factor ablation.

steps.title: 把膝部MRI读成2.5D窗口并聚合为研究级logits
steps.titleEN: Read knee MRI as 2.5D windows and aggregate to study-level logits
steps.body: 输入是五类采集组（矢状/冠状的流体敏感与非流体敏感、轴位）的切片。操作：按 DICOM 物理几何排序、标准化膝朝向、对缺失视图做掩码；约 140mm 视野缩放到 224/384/512px；每个 2.5D 窗口堆叠同一序列的三张相邻切片作为三通道输入，由 BiT ResNetV2-50、ConvNeXt-Small、DINOv3 ViT-B/16 或 CoAtNet 编码，再经类特定空间池化、全局平均池化与注意力 MIL 聚合成 12 个研究级 logits；代表性缓存按组分配 18/14/12/8/12 个中心位置共至多 64 个，缺失位置掩码。动机是在有限显存下同时利用层内局部结构与跨层上下文。局限：推理只覆盖缓存中的有效窗口，而非全部原始 DICOM 切片。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are slices from five acquisition groups (sagittal/coronal fluid-sensitive and non-fluid-sensitive, and axial). Slices are sorted by DICOM physical geometry, knee orientation is standardized and missing views masked; a roughly 140 mm field of view is resized to 224/384/512 px. Each 2.5D window stacks three adjacent slices from one series as a three-channel input, encoded by BiT ResNetV2-50, ConvNeXt-Small, DINOv3 ViT-B/16 or CoAtNet, then aggregated into 12 study logits by class-specific spatial pooling, global average pooling and attention MIL. A representative cache allocates 18/14/12/8/12 center positions per group, up to 64, with missing positions masked. The motivation is to exploit both in-slice local structure and cross-slice context under limited memory. Limitation: inference covers valid cached windows, not every raw DICOM slice.

steps.title: 可选深度注意力与OA耦合头
steps.titleEN: Optional depth attention and OA-coupled head
steps.body: 输入是同一序列内的窗口特征。操作：深度上下文（36 个成员中的 31 个）在序列内用 32 维投影、2×2 区域池化与 4 个注意力头交换特征，训练包保留序列块并以 32 个窗口为上限；OA 耦合（36 个中的 5 个）学习区域软骨等级，把累积序数预测转为分室最大值加学习残差，只修改三个 OA logits，其余九个不变，OAI 等级仅用于训练监督而耦合预测头在测试时仍生效。动机是让网络利用层间物理位置信息并对 OA 相关的三个发现建模序数结构。局限：这些是作者的配置选择，作者未将其作为单独消融报告收益，且“特征路径为示意而非实测注意力图”。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are window features within a series. Depth context (31 of 36 members) exchanges features using 32-dimensional projections, 2x2 regional pooling and four attention heads within each series, with training bags preserving series blocks capped at 32 windows. OA coupling (5 of 36) learns regional cartilage grades, converting cumulative ordinal predictions into compartment-wise maxima plus learned residuals that modify only the three OA logits while the other nine stay unchanged; OAI grades supervise training only and the coupled head remains active at test time. The motivation is to use physical position between slices and to model ordinal structure for the three OA-related findings. Limitation: these are the authors' configuration choices, not isolated ablations, and figure features are 'schematic, not measured attention maps'.

steps.title: 固定分组预算的概率融合与Gold58重训
steps.titleEN: Group-budget probability fusion and Gold58 refits
steps.body: 输入是各成员对 12 个发现的 sigmoid 概率。操作：基础预测 B[c] = 0.5·mean(Mature12) + 0.5·mean(Matrix20)，其余九个发现用 B[c]；三个弱发现用 P[c] = 0.5·B[c] + 0.5·mean(Expert8)；四个共享 checkpoint 只推理一次但保留两组贡献，得 12+20+8−4=36 个唯一模型，八个专家成员合计获得弱发现 58.33% 的展开权重；随后在冻结 G36 后将可匹配成员替换为含 58 个专家标签研究的重训版本（27 个重训+9 个原 checkpoint），分组与融合不变。动机是防止某架构的实验数或种子数自动决定其权重，并给弱发现额外专家支持。局限：作者自己指出 0.959 的三位小数既未确立 Gold 重训收益也未确立分组优势，且未用重训后的样本内分数重选成员；本方案是可复现的集成工程，而非单因素消融证据。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are each member's sigmoid probabilities for 12 findings. The base prediction is B[c] = 0.5·mean(Mature12) + 0.5·mean(Matrix20), used for the other nine findings; the weak three use P[c] = 0.5·B[c] + 0.5·mean(Expert8). Four shared checkpoints are inferred once but keep contributions in both groups, giving 12+20+8-4 = 36 unique models, with the eight expert members receiving 58.33% of expanded weak-finding weight. After freezing G36, eligible members are replaced by refits including the 58 expert-labeled studies (27 refits + 9 original checkpoints) with grouping and fusion fixed. The motivation is to stop the number of experiments or seeds for one architecture from determining its share, and to give weak findings extra expert support. Limitation: the authors note the three-decimal 0.959 establishes neither a Gold-refit benefit nor a grouping advantage, and post-refit in-sample scores were not used to reselect members; this is reproducible ensemble engineering, not single-factor ablation evidence.
steps.reference: 4. G36-Gold: fixed group budgets, finding-specific support

llmReview.reason: 该方案详细披露了可复用的建模与集成方法：多模态软标签构建、2.5D 多切片读取器、深度注意力、OAI 外部监督混合、组感知概率融合公式及固定 epoch 训练配方，并附完整训练/推理代码与权重链接，读者可追踪其建模与优化决策。

lessons.titleEN: From Report-Derived Soft Labels to 2.5D MRI Readers: Dissecting the 3rd-Place RSNA Knee Abnormality Solution
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to predict 12 knee abnormality labels from MRI with ROC AUC, yet only 58 of 4,407 training studies had expert-adjudicated labels while the rest only had multilingual reports. The authors built multimodal soft labels (version N) by having GPT-6 Astra review MRI together with the report, then had finding-specific readers refine PF OA, Lateral OA and Synovitis and applied quantile mapping within accepted revisions to preserve ordering (version R). They trained 2.5D readers (three adjacent slices stacked as channels, BiT/ConvNeXt/DINOv3/CoAtNet backbones, optional depth attention and OA-coupled head) and ensembled them with fixed group budgets. The core difficulties are the mismatch between image-level evaluation and report-derived supervision, label noise, and ensemble weights drifting with the number of experiments.
lessons.takeawayEN: Supervision quality and construction may matter more than architecture: generate continuous soft labels from image plus report, refine them per finding, and blend probabilities under fixed group budgets. Also note that at three-decimal leaderboard precision, 0.959 does not prove a benefit from Gold58 refits or the grouping strategy.

exercise.zh: 在公开 Notebook 基础上做小规模对照：固定同一骨干与同一个 seed，仅改变监督构造，比较 (a) 仅用报告文本标签、(b) 图像+报告软标签 N、(c) 对单一发现应用分位数映射的 R 三种设置下的局部 AUC，并记录每种设置下有多少样本被修正；借此检验软标签与分位数映射是否真的带来提升，而不是直接照搬融合权重。
exercise.en: On top of the public notebook, run a small controlled comparison: fix the same backbone and seed and vary only supervision construction, comparing the local AUC of (a) report-text-only labels, (b) image+report soft targets (N), and (c) R with quantile mapping for a single finding, while logging how many samples were revised in each setting. This tests whether soft labels and quantile mapping actually help instead of copying the ensemble weights.

lessons.originalTitle: 1st Place Solution - Our Journey to Becoming Professional Farmers
lessons.author: M & M & P & Q
lessons.title: 让农场智能体先模仿，再用自博弈修正策略
lessons.summary: 农场游戏要经过很多回合才知道输赢。冠军先让策略模仿公开回放，给自博弈一个起点；发现某类局面一直处理不好时，再补入针对性示范，恢复 PPO 训练。
lessons.takeaway: 找一类反复输掉的局面，分别评估补示范前、模仿后和自博弈后的策略。

steps.title: 数据与特征
steps.titleEN: Observations
steps.body: 模型同时利用双方农场、市场与公开游戏状态，并从公开信息估计对手隐藏库存。
steps.bodyEN: Observations combine both farms, the market and public game state. Hidden opponent inventory is estimated from public information.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.titleEN: Alternating imitation and PPO
steps.body: 先用公开策略的示范初始化，再通过自博弈训练。发现策略缺口时用短暂模仿阶段补上行为，之后继续优化胜负回报。
steps.bodyEN: The team initialized from demonstrations, moved to PPO self-play, and inserted short imitation phases when the current policy lacked a useful strategy.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.titleEN: Action corrections
steps.body: 最终方案用规则处理库存和动作冲突。一个提交在推理时修正，另一个还在训练回合中纳入这些规则，使训练时看到的动作更接近部署。
steps.bodyEN: Final agents corrected inventory and conflicting actions. One applied corrections at inference. Another also included them during training rollouts to better match deployment.

lessons.titleEN: Teach a farming policy by imitation, then refine it in self-play
lessons.summaryEN: Games have long horizons and delayed outcomes. The winners initialized a policy from public replays, then trained it in self-play. When replay analysis revealed a missing behavior, they introduced targeted demonstrations and resumed PPO.
lessons.takeawayEN: Choose a recurring losing situation and evaluate the policy before demonstrations, after imitation and after resumed self-play.

exercise.zh: 固定对手与开局，把目标策略出现的次数和整局胜率分开记录。模仿后目标动作更常见，可能只是学会了照做；若下一轮自博弈后同一对手上的胜率也上升，才有依据继续研究它在决策链中的价值。
exercise.en: Fix opponents and starting positions. Count the targeted behavior separately from game wins. Imitation can increase the frequency of an action without improving play. Evaluate it again after self-play to see whether the agent has learned when to use it.

lessons.originalTitle: 2nd - Trading clutch, and no B200s harmed!
lessons.author: Victor @ Tufa Labs
lessons.title: 2nd - Trading clutch, and no B200s harmed!
lessons.summary: 获奖队伍已公开赛后复盘，最终名次已与队伍记录核对。
lessons.takeaway: 先阅读作者的验证设计与模型选择，再对照最终成绩。

lessons.originalTitle: 1st Place - TFMs and LLMs with tabular data!
lessons.author: Chris Deotte
lessons.title: 把一行表格当作文本，从两个候选标签反推满意度
lessons.summary: 冠军把每个字段写成可读文本，分别假设旅客满意和不满意，让语言模型评估哪种假设更能解释这一行特征。这种打分方式与已有表格模型犯的错不同，因此还被加入最终融合。
lessons.takeaway: 在一小批留出行上固定字段顺序，对比标签放在开头和末尾的 AUC 与推理开销。

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.titleEN: The row as text
steps.body: 每一列写成“列名 is 取值”，按顺序拼成句子。原文用 GPT-2，因而无需为每个字段单设编码器。
steps.bodyEN: Each field becomes “column is value” and the fields form one sequence. The writeup uses GPT-2 without a separate tokenizer for each feature.
steps.reference: How to make two new kinds of tabular LLMs

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.titleEN: Two ways to score a row
steps.body: 标签在末尾时模型根据特征预测标签；放在开头时，分别给定两个标签，比较产生已观测字段的可能性。后者需要多次前向计算。
steps.bodyEN: With a target-last sequence the model predicts the label from the features. With a target-first sequence it scores the observed features under each possible label, requiring additional forward passes.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.titleEN: Contribution to the blend
steps.body: 作者在含 245 对公开折外与测试预测的堆叠模型上加入自己的分类器，用本地和公开榜分数比较加入前后的表现。
steps.bodyEN: The team added its classifiers to a stack using 245 public pairs of out-of-fold and test predictions and compared validation and public leaderboard scores.
steps.reference: Adding the GPT classifier to the stack

lessons.titleEN: Read a table row under two candidate labels
lessons.summaryEN: The winners serialized each row as text and scored it twice, assuming either a satisfied or dissatisfied passenger. The model that better explains the observed features receives more support. Its predictions added diversity to an existing blend.
lessons.takeawayEN: On held-out rows, fix the feature order and compare AUC and inference cost for target-first and target-last scoring.

exercise.zh: 同一行先写“满意”，再写“不满意”，只改变这一个前缀，记录两种条件下后续字段的对数似然。对差值很小的行，调换字段顺序再测一次。单独记录模型得分和加入融合后的变化，可以看出它贡献的是独立强度还是互补性。
exercise.en: Score the same row twice, changing only the candidate label prefix. Record the log likelihood of the remaining features under both labels. For near ties, change the feature order and rerun. Report standalone performance separately from the gain when adding it to a blend.

lessons.title: 用历史观测和自博弈比较策略版本
lessons.summary: 冠军用历史观测维护地图状态，再用多智能体强化学习训练决策策略。通过与旧版本对战检查新策略是否进步。
lessons.takeaway: 留下一组固定对手和游戏种子，再比较新旧策略的胜率。
lessons.author: Flat Neurons

steps.title: 数据与特征
steps.body: 地图特征包含距离上次观测某格子经过的步数，用于表示部分可观测环境中的历史信息。
steps.bodyEN: Map features include the number of steps since a tile was last observed, representing the age of information under partial observability.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 队伍以 IMPALA 和 V-trace 训练多智能体策略，并调整奖励尺度和熵。
steps.bodyEN: The team trained multi-agent policies with IMPALA and V-trace and adjusted reward scale and entropy.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 通过大量自博弈及对旧版本、教师版本的胜率比较，评估策略迭代。
steps.bodyEN: They evaluated policy updates through extensive self-play and win-rate comparisons against old and teacher versions.

lessons.titleEN: Use observation history and self-play to compare policies
lessons.summaryEN: The winners maintained map state from previous observations, then trained a multi-agent policy. They checked progress by playing new policies against earlier versions.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep a fixed set of opponents and game seeds and compare win rates for old and new policies.

exercise.zh: 在回放中挑一个刚离开视野的格子，标记智能体最后观测它的时间。比较有无历史特征时下一步动作是否变化，再用多组固定对手验证。单局获胜只能作案例，胜率比较还要看对局数量和先后手。
exercise.en: Pick a tile that just left view and mark when the policy last observed it. Compare its next action with and without the history feature, then test against several fixed opponents. Treat one win as an example and report the game count and starting side with win rates.

lessons.title: 用多视角一致性修正图像匹配
lessons.author: ZJU3DV
lessons.summary: 一对照片中可信的匹配点，放到多个视角里可能互相矛盾。冠军融合稀疏与稠密匹配，先建粗模型，再迭代细化几何关系。
lessons.takeaway: 先在一个小场景跑通粗重建，再单独打开迭代细化，对比恢复的相机和位姿误差。

steps.title: 数据构造
steps.body: 先挑选有重叠的图像对，检测旋转与重叠区域，减少明显无意义的匹配。
steps.bodyEN: They selected overlapping image pairs and identified rotation and overlap to avoid uninformative matching work.

steps.title: 匹配与重建
steps.body: 稀疏与稠密方法产生互补候选。团队在粗 SfM 前按置信度合并候选，处理同一点在多张图中的不一致。
steps.bodyEN: Sparse and dense matchers proposed complementary points. Before coarse SfM the team merged proposals by confidence to reconcile inconsistent correspondences across images.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 以粗相机和已匹配点为起点迭代细化。逐步记录各场景的重建结果，区分匹配不足和几何优化错误。
steps.bodyEN: Starting from coarse cameras and matched points, they refined iteratively. Track reconstruction results per scene to separate insufficient matches from geometry errors.

lessons.titleEN: Resolve conflicting image matches across views
lessons.summaryEN: A plausible match between two photos may conflict with evidence from other views. The winners combined sparse and dense matches, built a coarse reconstruction and refined the geometry iteratively.
lessons.takeawayEN: Run a coarse reconstruction on one small scene, then switch on refinement alone and compare recovered cameras and pose error.

exercise.zh: 选三张有重叠的照片，在第一张标出一个点，沿两条路径找到它在第三张中的位置。若两条路径不一致，回查遮挡、重复纹理和匹配置信度。记录细化前后可恢复的相机数以及误差，避免只看成功场景。
exercise.en: Mark one point in the first of three overlapping photos and trace it to the third via two paths. If the paths disagree, inspect occlusion, repeated texture and confidence. Record recovered cameras and errors before and after refinement, including failed scenes.

lessons.title: 在几何排布中兼顾可行性与种群多样性
lessons.summary: 冠军方案以遗传算法探索布局，用局部优化减少图块重叠与越界。选择阶段同时考虑代价和布局差异。
lessons.takeaway: 对小规模布局固定边界和随机种子，分别记录可行率、重叠代价与最终边长。
lessons.author: Jeroen Cottaar

steps.title: 模型与优化
steps.body: 通过单个布局的变异及两个布局的交叉产生候选；变异可改变图块的位置和旋转角度。
steps.bodyEN: Mutation changes one layout, including piece positions and rotations. Crossover builds candidates from two layouts.

steps.title: 评估设计
steps.body: 用图块重叠及超出正方形边界的程度构造代价，GPU 局部优化尝试把候选修正为可行解。
steps.bodyEN: A cost measures overlap and protrusion beyond the square. GPU local optimization attempts to repair candidates into feasible layouts.

steps.title: 候选筛选与复现
steps.body: 在每个子种群中保留代价低的部分布局，再结合差异性挑选其余候选。
steps.bodyEN: Each subpopulation keeps some low-cost layouts and uses dissimilarity when selecting the rest.

lessons.titleEN: Balance feasibility and population diversity in packing
lessons.summaryEN: The winning genetic search explores layouts and uses local optimization to reduce overlaps and boundary violations. Selection considers both cost and differences between layouts.
lessons.takeawayEN: On a small instance, fix the boundary and random seed. Record feasibility, overlap cost and final side length separately.

exercise.zh: 在相同边长下从两种布局开始：一种紧凑但略有重叠，另一种留有空隙。给它们相同的局部优化预算，记录能否修复。然后比较仅保留低代价候选与保留不同布局的搜索，观察是否反复卡在同一位置。
exercise.en: At the same side length, start from a tight layout with slight overlap and a looser layout. Give them equal repair budgets. Compare selection by cost alone against keeping dissimilar layouts, and inspect whether the search returns to the same stalled arrangement.

lessons.title: 用整分子上下文预测原子对性质
lessons.summary: 冠军团队将完整分子送入图模型，同时为其中多个原子对预测耦合常数。分层表示将不同粒度的原子和原子对信息组合在一起。
lessons.takeaway: 保留相同数据划分，比较仅使用原子对特征与加入整分子上下文后的误差。
lessons.author: hybrid

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.body: 作者为原子及原子对构建不同细粒度的嵌入，例如在原子类型之外加入连接关系信息。
steps.bodyEN: The authors built embeddings at several resolutions for atoms and pairs, adding connectivity information beyond atom type.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 图 Transformer 风格的模型一次处理整个分子，同时输出多个耦合值。
steps.bodyEN: A graph Transformer-style architecture processes a whole molecule and emits multiple coupling predictions in one pass.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 队伍训练了多个模型进行融合，公开仓库保留了架构变体，便于追溯最终预测。
steps.bodyEN: The team ensembled several models. Their public repository contains architectural variants that help trace the final prediction.

lessons.titleEN: Use the whole molecule to predict atom-pair properties
lessons.summaryEN: The winners sent a complete molecule through a graph model and predicted several coupling constants together. Hierarchical representations combined information about atoms and their pairs at different levels of detail.
lessons.takeawayEN: On the same split, compare pair-only inputs with inputs that include whole-molecule context.

exercise.zh: 选一个分子中的两个原子对，把每个原子的局部信息与整个分子的连接信息分列。先看只用局部特征时哪组误差最大，再加入全图上下文，在相同耦合类型内比较，以免不同类型的数值尺度掩盖变化。
exercise.en: For two pairs in one molecule, separate local atom descriptors from connectivity across the graph. Identify the larger error with pair-only inputs, then add global context. Compare within coupling type so differences in numeric scale do not obscure the effect.

lessons.title: 把分子结构识别拆成候选生成与重排
lessons.summary: 第三名方案先生成多个可能的结构字符串，再检验它们是否有效，并用多个模型重新评分。可分别检查错误发生在候选生成还是排序环节。
lessons.takeaway: 先统计正确结果是否进入候选集，再评价重排能否把正确候选提到首位。
lessons.author: kyamaro

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 团队观察到测试图中椒盐噪声更多，随后在训练图像中加入相应噪声增强。
steps.bodyEN: The team saw more salt-and-pepper noise in test images and added similar noise to training images.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 用多种图像编码器和文本解码器生成 InChI 候选，通过束搜索扩大候选范围。
steps.bodyEN: Several image encoders and text decoders generated InChI candidates. Beam search expanded the candidate pool.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 先检查候选结构是否合法，再用多个模型对图像与候选的匹配损失评分，据此重排。
steps.bodyEN: Invalid candidates were removed. Several models then scored image–candidate matching losses to rerank the remaining strings.

lessons.titleEN: Separate candidate generation from molecular reranking
lessons.summaryEN: The third-place team proposed multiple structural strings, checked their validity and rescored them with several models. This separates errors in generating a candidate from errors in choosing it.
lessons.takeawayEN: Measure how often the true string reaches the candidate set, then how often reranking moves it to first place.

exercise.zh: 把一批图像分成三组：正确字符串没有进入候选集、进入但未排首位、已经排首位。第一组提示需要检查生成器，第二组适合试重排。报告总体编辑距离时，再分别记录这三组的占比。
exercise.en: Group images by whether the correct string was absent from the pool, present but not first, or already first. The first group points to generation and the second to reranking. Report these proportions alongside aggregate edit distance.

lessons.title: 从匿名数值的出现次数提取信号
lessons.author: Wizardry
lessons.summary: 字段没有业务名称，但数值是否重复仍携带信号。冠军围绕每列取值出现的次数构造特征，再融合树模型和专门设计的神经网络。
lessons.takeaway: 对一列做频次编码，在验证集上与原始数值对照，检验规律能否迁移到你的数据。

steps.title: 数据观察
steps.body: 团队逐列分析只出现一次与重复出现的取值，发现不同样本群体的频次结构不同。
steps.bodyEN: The team inspected unique and repeated values column by column and found different frequency patterns across groups of examples.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 原始特征与衍生特征分别进入 LightGBM 和定制网络。原文列出两种模型的单模成绩。
steps.bodyEN: Raw and derived features were used in LightGBM and a custom network. The writeup reports individual scores for both models.

steps.title: 复现边界
steps.body: 部分构造利用该比赛特有的数据生成规律。复现时先列清推理时可见的样本范围，再比较两类模型融合后的误差。
steps.bodyEN: Some features depended on the competition’s data-generation process. Define which rows are visible at inference before comparing ensemble errors.

lessons.titleEN: Extract signal from the frequency of anonymized values
lessons.summaryEN: The anonymous columns still reveal whether a value repeats. The winners engineered per-column frequency features and combined tree models with a custom neural network.
lessons.takeawayEN: Frequency-encode one column and compare it with raw values on a held-out split before generalizing to another dataset.

exercise.zh: 手算一列训练值的频次表，再把验证集中的已见值、未见值分开编码。若把验证集也纳入计数会改变特征，应把两种设置作为独立实验记录。最后比较原始值、仅频次、两者合用。
exercise.en: Compute a count table for one training column and encode seen and unseen validation values separately. If including holdout rows in the counts changes features, log that as a distinct experiment. Compare raw values, counts alone and their combination.

lessons.title: 让声音事件检测器保留更多时频细节
lessons.summary: 这份冠军队员的复盘讲解了融合系统中的一个分支：减小卷积网络首层步幅，保留更细的时间和频率分辨率，再对长录音片段进行多标签训练。
lessons.takeaway: 在相同输入和训练预算下，对照首层步幅与背景噪声增强的效果。
lessons.author: KDL

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.body: 将卷积编码器的首层步幅从 2×2 改为 1×1，使后续特征图保留更多时频位置。
steps.bodyEN: The encoder’s first stride was reduced from 2×2 to 1×1 so later feature maps retained more time–frequency locations.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 在 15 秒片段上结合次要标签训练，用背景录音和其他噪声进行增强，并根据主要鸟种调整采样与损失权重。
steps.bodyEN: The branch trained on 15-second segments with secondary labels, added background recordings and other noise, and adjusted sampling and loss weights by primary species.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 作者保留三个检查点并对模型权重取平均。队伍的最终融合还包括 BirdNET 和其他成员的模型。
steps.bodyEN: The author averaged three checkpoints’ weights. The final team ensemble also included BirdNET and models from other members.

lessons.titleEN: Preserve fine time–frequency detail in a bird-call detector
lessons.summaryEN: This winning-team member explains one branch of the ensemble. A smaller initial stride preserves temporal and frequency resolution, and the branch learns multiple labels from longer audio segments.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep inputs and training budget fixed while comparing the initial stride and background-noise augmentation.

exercise.zh: 在同一段频谱图上标出一声很短的鸟鸣。比较首层步幅为 1 和 2 时，中间特征图还剩多少时间位置。缩小步幅会增加计算量，因此除验证分数外，还要在相同硬件上记录推理耗时。
exercise.en: Mark a short call on one spectrogram. Compare how many time positions remain in an intermediate feature map with first-layer strides of one and two. Smaller strides cost computation, so record inference time on the same hardware alongside validation quality.

lessons.title: 用场地对称性预测推进距离
lessons.author: The Zoo
lessons.summary: 向球场左侧或右侧跑动可以有相同的推进距离。冠军同时翻转横向坐标及相对特征，并在推理时融合镜像输入的预测。
lessons.takeaway: 先把同一场比赛放进同一折，再测试镜像增强，避免相邻回合泄漏到验证集。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 按 GameId 做 5 折 GroupKFold，验证时仅评估 2018 赛季样本。作者报告该设置与公开榜相关性较好。
steps.bodyEN: They used five-fold GroupKFold by GameId and evaluated only 2018-season examples during validation. The authors reported good agreement with the public board.

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 同一次跑动包含攻守双方的多名球员。构造相对位置时保持跑动方向一致，让表示可在回合之间比较。
steps.bodyEN: Each rushing play contains several offensive and defensive players. A consistent running direction makes relative positions comparable across plays.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 对横坐标方向以外的横场 Y 轴做镜像，并同步变换派生特征。分别预测原始与镜像阵形再融合。
steps.bodyEN: They reflected the sideline-to-sideline Y axis and adjusted derived features consistently. Predictions from the original and mirrored formations were blended.

lessons.titleEN: Exploit field symmetry to predict rushing yards
lessons.summaryEN: Runs on opposite sides of the field can lead to the same gain. The winners reflected lateral coordinates and their derived features, then blended predictions from the original and mirrored formations.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep each game in one fold before testing mirror augmentation, so neighboring plays do not leak into validation.

exercise.zh: 画出一个回合的持球队员和最近防守者，同时画出镜像。两者的距离应相同，而横向速度符号应相反。先用这些关系检查变换是否一致，再比较原始、仅镜像和两者融合后的累计概率曲线。
exercise.en: Plot the ball carrier and nearest defender before and after reflection. Their distance should stay constant while lateral velocity changes sign. Check these invariants first, then compare cumulative predictions from original, mirrored and blended inputs.

comparisons.text: BirdCLEF 2023 先按时长、上传者和鸟种找出重复录音。2022 冠军队的一个模型则缩小首层步幅，保留更细的时频变化。复现鸟声基线时，可以先清理重复样本，再单独测试频谱分辨率的影响。
comparisons.textEN: BirdCLEF 2023 screened for duplicate recordings by duration, uploader and species. A 2022 branch reduced the first stride to retain finer time–frequency changes. Clean the audio collection first, then test spectrogram resolution in a separate experiment.

comparisons.text: 两届 BirdCLEF 方案在不同阶段合并信息。2023 将注意力预测与时间维度上的最大预测组合，2022 的一个分支先平均三个检查点的权重，再参加队伍融合。可以分别记录两种操作带来的分数变化。
comparisons.textEN: The two BirdCLEF solutions combine information at different stages. The 2023 team combined attention predictions with temporal maxima. A 2022 branch averaged three checkpoints before entering the team ensemble. Measure each operation separately.

comparisons.text: BirdCLEF 2023 用五折分层验证比较模型，2024 则发现某一折特别容易，并用信号强度检查差异。验证鸟声模型时，可以同时记录各折的类别分布、录音能量和单折成绩。
comparisons.textEN: BirdCLEF 2023 compared models on five stratified folds. The 2024 team investigated an unusually easy fold using signal strength. Track class mix, recording energy and scores per fold when validating a bird-call model.

comparisons.text: 两届 BirdCLEF 都训练卷积网络识别鸟声。2022 的一个分支用 15 秒片段和次要鸟种标签训练，2024 把 10 秒片段转成 128 个 Mel 频带。比较窗口长度时，可以固定频谱配置与验证划分。
comparisons.textEN: Both BirdCLEF solutions trained convolutional networks. A 2022 branch used 15-second clips with secondary labels, while the 2024 team converted 10-second clips to 128 Mel bands. Hold the split and spectrogram settings fixed when comparing window lengths.

comparisons.text: BMS 从分子图像生成多个结构字符串，CHAMPS 则把已知分子的原子和连接关系作为输入，同时预测多个原子对的性质。迁移方法前，先确定结构是要预测的目标，还是可以提供给模型的输入。
comparisons.textEN: BMS generates structural strings from images. CHAMPS starts with atoms and their connections and predicts properties of several pairs at once. Before transferring a method, establish whether structure is a prediction target or an input you already have.

comparisons.text: BMS 先排除无效分子结构，再用多个模型给候选排序。CHAMPS 直接融合多个模型预测的连续数值。两者的输出形式不同，可以分别检验候选排序和数值融合的收益。
comparisons.textEN: BMS discards invalid structures and combines model scores to rank candidates. CHAMPS combines continuous numerical predictions. Evaluate candidate ranking and numerical blending against their respective output types.
